name: EOC.LogAbsorb.log_absorb

    C * Real.logb 2 n + θ * n ≤ θ' * n

    (hn : (3 * C / (θ' - θ)) ^ 2 ≤ n) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (C * Real.logb 2 n + θ * n) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (θ' * n)

theorem residue_pinning (m0 N : ℕ) (hm0 : Odd m0)

name: EOC.coarse_depth_window
statement:
theorem coarse_depth_window (d : ℕ → ℕ) (m0 N : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hagg : 2 ^ S d N ∣ (3 ^ N * m0 + q d N))
    (hconf : Confined c d (N - 1))
    (hexit : c < R d N) :
    Confined c (fun i => if i = N - 1 then a (iter d m0 (N - 1)) else d i) (N - 1)
    ∧ c < R (fun i => if i = N - 1 then a (iter d m0 (N - 1)) else d i) N

EOC.rmin_mono

theorem rmin_mono (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ)

name: EOC.single_window_equiv
statement:
theorem single_window_equiv
    (c ε : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hε_pos : 0 < ε) (hε_le : ε ≤ 2) :
    (∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N →
       ∀ d : ℕ → ℕ,
         (∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) →
         Confined c d N →
         3 ≤ leastRealizer d N →
         (2:ℝ) ^ (ε * (N:ℝ)) ≤ (leastRealizer d N : ℝ))
    ↔
    (∀ m0 : ℕ, Odd m0 → 3 ≤ m0 →
       ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N →
         Confined c (fun i => a (orbit m0 i)) N →
         (2:ℝ) ^ (ε * (N:ℝ)) ≤ (m0 : ℝ))

name: EOC.single_window_equiv_log
statement:
theorem single_window_equiv_log
    (c ε : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hε_pos : 0 < ε) (hε_le : ε ≤ 2) :
    (∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N →
       ∀ d : ℕ → ℕ,
         (∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) →
         Confined c d N →
         3 ≤ leastRealizer d N →
         ε * (N : ℝ) ≤ Real.logb 2 (leastRealizer d N))
    ↔
    (∀ m0 : ℕ, Odd m0 → 3 ≤ m0 →
       ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N →
         Confined c (fun i => a (orbit m0 i)) N →
         ε * (N : ℝ) ≤ Real.logb 2 m0)

theorem card_filter_le_mul_card (hN : 0 < N) (K : ℕ → ℕ)

    ((feasibleWords N (K N)).filter fun w => P w.total).card ≤

statement:
theorem chordRot_spec (hN : 0 < N) (w : FiniteValuationWord N) :

name: EOC.CapacityBounds.collatz_capacity_sandwich
statement:
theorem collatz_capacity_sandwich (c : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    Nat.choose (collatzBarrier c N - 1) (N - 1) ≤ Nat.choose (collatzBarrier c N) N ∧
      Nat.choose (collatzBarrier c N) N ≤ N * (confinedWords N (collatzBarrier c)).card ∧
      N * (confinedWords N (collatzBarrier c)).card ≤ N * Nat.choose (collatzBarrier c N) N

name: EOC.CapacityBounds.collatz_chord

theorem collatz_chord (c : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    ∀ j ≤ N, ∀ p : ℕ, N * p ≤ j * collatzBarrier c N → p ≤ collatzBarrier c j

name: EOC.CapacityBounds.collatz_shell_lower

    (hs : s ≤ collatzBarrier c N) :
    Nat.choose (s - 1) (N - 1) ≤
      N * ((confinedWords N (collatzBarrier c)).filter fun w => w.total = s).card

statement:
theorem mem_feasibleWords {B : ℕ} {w : FiniteValuationWord N} :
    w ∈ feasibleWords N B ↔ w.Positive ∧ w.total ≤ B

name: EOC.CapacityBounds.mem_shellWords
statement:
theorem mem_shellWords {s : ℕ} {w : FiniteValuationWord N} :
    w ∈ shellWords N s ↔ w.Positive ∧ w.total = s

name: EOC.CapacityBounds.positive_of_mem_box
statement:
theorem positive_of_mem_box {B : ℕ} {w : FiniteValuationWord N} (h : w ∈ box N B) :
    w.Positive

name: EOC.CapacityBounds.rotate_mod
statement: theorem rotate_mod (w : FiniteValuationWord N) (k : ℕ) : w.rotate (k % N) = w.rotate k

name: EOC.CapacityBounds.rotate_rotate
statement:
theorem rotate_rotate (w : FiniteValuationWord N) (r k : ℕ) :
    (w.rotate r).rotate k = w.rotate (r + k)

name: EOC.CapacityBounds.rotate_self_length
statement: theorem rotate_self_length (w : FiniteValuationWord N) : w.rotate N = w

name: EOC.CapacityBounds.shell_choose_le_mul_card
statement:
theorem shell_choose_le_mul_card (hN : 1 ≤ N) (K : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hchord : ∀ j ≤ N, ∀ p : ℕ, N * p ≤ j * K N → p ≤ K j) {s : ℕ} (hNs : N ≤ s)
    (hsK : s ≤ K N) :
    Nat.choose (s - 1) (N - 1) ≤ N * ((confinedWords N K).filter fun w => w.total = s).card

name: EOC.CapacityBounds.total_le_of_barrierConfined
statement:
theorem total_le_of_barrierConfined (hN : 1 ≤ N) {K : ℕ → ℕ} {w : FiniteValuationWord N}
    (h : BarrierConfined K w) : w.total ≤ K N

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.T_le_T_self
statement: theorem T_le_T_self (n k j : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) : T n k j ≤ T n k k

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.T_le_succ
statement: theorem T_le_succ (n k j : ℕ) (hjk : j < k) (hkn : k ≤ n) : T n k j ≤ T n k (j + 1)

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.T_succ
statement:
theorem T_succ (n k j : ℕ) (hj : j < n) :
    T n k (j + 1) * ((j + 1) * (n - k)) = T n k j * ((n - j) * k)

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.T_succ_le
statement: theorem T_succ_le (n k j : ℕ) (hkj : k ≤ j) (hkn : k < n) : T n k (j + 1) ≤ T n k j

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.alpha_entropy_eq
statement: theorem alpha_entropy_eq : f alpha = alpha * Real.binEntropy alpha⁻¹

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.cast_prod_pos
statement:
theorem cast_prod_pos (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    (0 : ℝ) < ((n.choose k * k ^ k * (n - k) ^ (n - k) : ℕ) : ℝ)

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.choose_mul_pow_le
statement:
theorem choose_mul_pow_le (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    n.choose k * k ^ k * (n - k) ^ (n - k) ≤ n ^ n

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.ent_eq_mul_f
statement:
theorem ent_eq_mul_f {s N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hNs : N ≤ s) :
    ent s N = N * f ((s : ℝ) / N)

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.ent_le_log_succ_add_log_choose
statement:
theorem ent_le_log_succ_add_log_choose (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    ent n k ≤ log ((n : ℝ) + 1) + log (n.choose k)

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.f_continuous
statement: theorem f_continuous : Continuous f

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.log_W_ge
statement:
theorem log_W_ge (c : ℕ) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    ent (collatzBarrier c N) N - log ((collatzBarrier c N : ℝ) + 1) - log N ≤ log (W c N)

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.log_W_le
statement:
theorem log_W_le (c : ℕ) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    log (W c N) ≤ ent (collatzBarrier c N) N

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.log_choose_le_ent
statement: theorem log_choose_le_ent (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) : log (n.choose k) ≤ ent n k

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.log_prod
statement:
theorem log_prod (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    log ((n.choose k * k ^ k * (n - k) ^ (n - k) : ℕ) : ℝ) =
      log (n.choose k) + k * log k + ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) * log ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ)

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.one_le_W
statement: theorem one_le_W (c : ℕ) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) : 1 ≤ W c N

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.pow_le_succ_mul_choose_mul_pow
statement:
theorem pow_le_succ_mul_choose_mul_pow (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    n ^ n ≤ (n + 1) * (n.choose k * k ^ k * (n - k) ^ (n - k))

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.self_pow_pos
statement: theorem self_pow_pos (k : ℕ) : 0 < k ^ k

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.sum_T
statement: theorem sum_T (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) : ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), T n k j = n ^ n

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.tendsto_barrier_div
statement:
theorem tendsto_barrier_div (c : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (collatzBarrier c N : ℝ) / N) atTop (𝓝 alpha)

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.tendsto_log_card_confined
statement:
theorem tendsto_log_card_confined (c : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => log (W c N) / N) atTop (𝓝 (f alpha))

name: EOC.EntropyBounds.tendsto_log_nat_div
statement: theorem tendsto_log_nat_div : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => log (N : ℝ) / N) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: EOC.PeriodicCore.bernoulli_nat
statement: theorem bernoulli_nat (A : Nat) : ∀ k, A ^ (k + 1) + (k + 1) * A ^ k ≤ (A + 1) ^ (k + 1)

name: EOC.PeriodicCore.block_shift_invariant
statement:
theorem block_shift_invariant (d : Nat → Nat) (j0 L : Nat) (h : EvPeriodic d j0 L) (k : Nat) :
    ∀ M, M ≤ L →
      qr (fun i => d (j0 + k * L + i)) M = qr (fun i => d (j0 + i)) M ∧
      sr (fun i => d (j0 + k * L + i)) M = sr (fun i => d (j0 + i)) M

name: EOC.PeriodicCore.evPeriodic_shift
statement:
theorem evPeriodic_shift (d : Nat → Nat) (j0 L : Nat) (h : EvPeriodic d j0 L) :
    ∀ k i, d (j0 + k * L + i) = d (j0 + i)

name: EOC.PeriodicCore.eventually_const_of_mono_bounded
statement:
theorem eventually_const_of_mono_bounded (r : Nat → Nat) (hmono : ∀ N, r N ≤ r (N + 1))
    (M : Nat) (hbd : ∀ N, r N ≤ M) :
    ∃ N0, ∀ N, N0 ≤ N → r N = r N0

name: EOC.PeriodicCore.exists_exit_of_block_growth
statement:
theorem exists_exit_of_block_growth (d : Nat → Nat) (j0 L : Nat) (h : EvPeriodic d j0 L)
    (hgrow : 3 ^ L < 2 ^ blockSum d j0 L) (c : Nat) :
    ∃ k, 3 ^ (j0 + k * L) * 2 ^ c < 2 ^ sr d (j0 + k * L)

name: EOC.PeriodicCore.mono_of_step
statement:
theorem mono_of_step (r : Nat → Nat) (hmono : ∀ N, r N ≤ r (N + 1)) :
    ∀ i j, i ≤ j → r i ≤ r j

name: EOC.PeriodicCore.pow_dominates
statement:
theorem pow_dominates (A B M : Nat) (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hAB : A < B) (hM : 1 ≤ M) :
    M * A ^ (M * A) < B ^ (M * A)

name: EOC.PeriodicCore.qr_pos
statement: theorem qr_pos (d : Nat → Nat) (L : Nat) (hL : 1 ≤ L) : 0 < qr d L

name: EOC.PeriodicCore.qr_succ
statement: theorem qr_succ (d : Nat → Nat) (j : Nat) : qr d (j + 1) = 3 * qr d j + 2 ^ sr d j

name: EOC.PeriodicCore.qr_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem qr_zero (d : Nat → Nat) : qr d 0 = 0

name: EOC.PeriodicCore.sr_add_window
statement:
theorem sr_add_window (d : Nat → Nat) (j : Nat) :
    ∀ L, sr d (j + L) = sr d j + sr (fun i => d (j + i)) L

name: EOC.PeriodicCore.sr_congr
statement:
theorem sr_congr (d d' : Nat → Nat) (L : Nat) (h : ∀ i, i < L → d i = d' i) :
    sr d L = sr d' L

name: EOC.PeriodicCore.sr_ge_of_pos
statement: theorem sr_ge_of_pos (d : Nat → Nat) (L : Nat) (hd : ∀ i, i < L → 1 ≤ d i) : L ≤ sr d L

name: EOC.PeriodicCore.sr_periodic
statement:
theorem sr_periodic (d : Nat → Nat) (j0 L : Nat) (h : EvPeriodic d j0 L) :
    ∀ k, sr d (j0 + k * L) = sr d j0 + k * blockSum d j0 L

name: EOC.PeriodicCore.sr_succ
statement: theorem sr_succ (d : Nat → Nat) (j : Nat) : sr d (j + 1) = sr d j + d j

name: EOC.PeriodicCore.sr_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem sr_zero (d : Nat → Nat) : sr d 0 = 0

name: EOC.PeriodicCore.three_pow_lt_two_pow_of_block_return
statement:
theorem three_pow_lt_two_pow_of_block_return
    (L S C : Nat) (y : Nat → Nat) (hS : 1 ≤ S) (hC : 0 < C)
    (hrec : ∀ r, 2 ^ S * y (r + 1) = 3 ^ L * y r + C) :
    3 ^ L < 2 ^ S

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.bernoulli_upper
statement: theorem bernoulli_upper (A : Nat) : ∀ k, (A + 1) ^ (k + 1) ≤ A ^ (k + 1) + (k + 1) * (A + 1) ^ k

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.cnt_eq_le_one
statement:
theorem cnt_eq_le_one (m : Nat → Nat) (hinj : ∀ i j, m i = m j → i = j) (b : Nat) :
    ∀ n, cnt (fun i => decide (m i = b)) n ≤ 1

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.cnt_le
statement: theorem cnt_le (p : Nat → Bool) : ∀ n, cnt p n ≤ n

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.cnt_of_false
statement: theorem cnt_of_false (p : Nat → Bool) : ∀ n, (∀ i, i < n → p i = false) → cnt p n = 0

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.cnt_of_true
statement: theorem cnt_of_true (p : Nat → Bool) : ∀ n, (∀ i, i < n → p i = true) → cnt p n = n

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.cnt_range_le
statement:
theorem cnt_range_le (m : Nat → Nat) (hinj : ∀ i j, m i = m j → i = j) (a : Nat) :
    ∀ b n, cnt (fun i => decide (a ≤ m i ∧ m i < b)) n ≤ b - a

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.cnt_split
statement:
theorem cnt_split (p q r : Nat → Bool)
    (hpqr : ∀ i, p i = (q i || r i)) (hdisj : ∀ i, ¬ (q i = true ∧ r i = true)) :
    ∀ n, cnt p n = cnt q n + cnt r n

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.cnt_succ
statement: theorem cnt_succ (p : Nat → Bool) (n : Nat) : cnt p (n + 1) = cnt p n + (if p n then 1 else 0)

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.cnt_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem cnt_zero (p : Nat → Bool) : cnt p 0 = 0

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.decide_split
statement:
theorem decide_split (P Q R : Prop) [Decidable P] [Decidable Q] [Decidable R] (h : P ↔ Q ∨ R) :
    decide P = (decide Q || decide R)

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.dyadic_chain
statement:
theorem dyadic_chain (m : Nat → Nat) (hm : ∀ i, 1 ≤ m i) (hinj : ∀ i j, m i = m j → i = j) (N : Nat) :
    ∀ k, 2 ^ k * prf (fun i => decide (m i < 2 ^ k)) (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N
        ≤ 3 ^ k * prf (fun i => decide (m i < 2 ^ k)) (fun i => 3 * m i) N

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.ite_or_add
statement:
theorem ite_or_add (b c : Bool) (h : ¬ (b = true ∧ c = true)) :
    (if (b || c) then 1 else 0) = (if b then 1 else 0) + (if c then 1 else 0)

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.ite_or_split
statement:
theorem ite_or_split (b c : Bool) (x : Nat) (h : ¬ (b = true ∧ c = true)) :
    (if (b || c) then x else 1) = (if b then x else 1) * (if c then x else 1)

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.no_injective_orbit_of_lower_drift
statement:
theorem no_injective_orbit_of_lower_drift (m d : Nat → Nat) (G : Nat)
    (hm : ∀ i, 1 ≤ m i) (hinj : ∀ i j, m i = m j → i = j)
    (hstep : ∀ i, 2 ^ d i * m (i + 1) = 3 * m i + 1)
    (hlow : ∀ j, 3 ^ j ≤ 2 ^ G * 2 ^ sr d j) : False

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.orbit_product_identity
statement:
theorem orbit_product_identity (m d : Nat → Nat)
    (hstep : ∀ i, 2 ^ d i * m (i + 1) = 3 * m i + 1) :
    ∀ j, 2 ^ sr d j * m j * pr (fun i => 3 * m i) j = 3 ^ j * m 0 * pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) j

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.packing_bound
statement:
theorem packing_bound (m : Nat → Nat) (hm : ∀ i, 1 ≤ m i) (hinj : ∀ i j, m i = m j → i = j)
    (N L : Nat) (hNL : N ≤ 2 ^ L) :
    2 ^ (L + 1) * pr (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N ≤ 3 ^ (L + 1) * pr (fun i => 3 * m i) N

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.pigeonhole
statement:
theorem pigeonhole (m : Nat → Nat) (hinj : ∀ i j, m i = m j → i = j) (N X : Nat)
    (h : ∀ j, j < N → 1 ≤ m j ∧ m j ≤ X) : N ≤ X

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.pr_add
statement: theorem pr_add (f : Nat → Nat) (j : Nat) : ∀ t, pr f (j + t) = pr f j * pr (fun i => f (j + i)) t

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.pr_eq_prf_true
statement: theorem pr_eq_prf_true (f : Nat → Nat) : ∀ n, pr f n = prf (fun _ => true) f n

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.pr_le_pr
statement: theorem pr_le_pr (f g : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) (h : ∀ i, i < n → f i ≤ g i) : pr f n ≤ pr g n

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.pr_pos
statement: theorem pr_pos (f : Nat → Nat) (hf : ∀ i, 1 ≤ f i) : ∀ n, 1 ≤ pr f n

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.pr_succ
statement: theorem pr_succ (f : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) : pr f (n + 1) = pr f n * f n

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.pr_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem pr_zero (f : Nat → Nat) : pr f 0 = 1

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.prf_level_bound
statement:
theorem prf_level_bound (m : Nat → Nat) (p : Nat → Bool) (n N : Nat) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hlow : ∀ i, i < N → p i = true → n ≤ m i) (hcnt : cnt p N ≤ n) :
    2 * prf p (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N ≤ 3 * prf p (fun i => 3 * m i) N

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.prf_level_termwise
statement:
theorem prf_level_termwise (m : Nat → Nat) (p : Nat → Bool) (n : Nat) :
    ∀ N, (∀ i, i < N → p i = true → n ≤ m i) →
      prf p (fun i => 3 * m i + 1) N * (3 * n) ^ cnt p N
        ≤ prf p (fun i => 3 * m i) N * (3 * n + 1) ^ cnt p N

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.prf_of_false
statement:
theorem prf_of_false (p : Nat → Bool) (f : Nat → Nat) :
    ∀ n, (∀ i, i < n → p i = false) → prf p f n = 1

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.prf_pos
statement: theorem prf_pos (p : Nat → Bool) (f : Nat → Nat) (hf : ∀ i, 1 ≤ f i) : ∀ n, 1 ≤ prf p f n

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.prf_split
statement:
theorem prf_split (p q r : Nat → Bool) (f : Nat → Nat)
    (hpqr : ∀ i, p i = (q i || r i)) (hdisj : ∀ i, ¬ (q i = true ∧ r i = true)) :
    ∀ n, prf p f n = prf q f n * prf r f n

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.prf_succ
statement:
theorem prf_succ (p : Nat → Bool) (f : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) :
    prf p f (n + 1) = prf p f n * (if p n then f n else 1)

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.prf_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem prf_zero (p : Nat → Bool) (f : Nat → Nat) : prf p f 0 = 1

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.prod_pm_le
statement:
theorem prod_pm_le (n : Nat) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (3 * n + 1) ^ n * (3 * n - 1) ^ n ≤ (3 * n) ^ n * (3 * n) ^ n

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.state_bound
statement:
theorem state_bound (m d : Nat → Nat) (G : Nat)
    (hm : ∀ i, 1 ≤ m i) (hinj : ∀ i j, m i = m j → i = j)
    (hstep : ∀ i, 2 ^ d i * m (i + 1) = 3 * m i + 1)
    (hlow : ∀ j, 3 ^ j ≤ 2 ^ G * 2 ^ sr d j)
    (N L : Nat) (hNL : N ≤ 2 ^ L) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ N → m j * 2 ^ (L + 1) ≤ 2 ^ G * m 0 * 3 ^ (L + 1)

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.two_pow_le_of_le
statement:
theorem two_pow_le_of_le (n t : Nat) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (ht : t ≤ n) :
    2 * (3 * n + 1) ^ t ≤ 3 * (3 * n) ^ t

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.two_pow_le_three_pred_pow
statement:
theorem two_pow_le_three_pred_pow (n : Nat) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    2 * (3 * n) ^ n ≤ 3 * (3 * n - 1) ^ n

name: EOC.BoundedDriftCore.two_pow_succ_le
statement: theorem two_pow_succ_le (n : Nat) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : 2 * (3 * n + 1) ^ n ≤ 3 * (3 * n) ^ n

name: EOC.R_periodic
statement:
theorem R_periodic
    (d : ℕ → ℕ)
    (j0 L : ℕ)
    (hper : EvPeriodic d j0 L)
    (k : ℕ) :
    R d (j0 + k * L)
      =
    R d j0
      + (k : ℝ)
        * ((blockSum d j0 L : ℝ) - alpha * L)

name: EOC.alpha_mul_lt_of_pow_lt
statement:
theorem alpha_mul_lt_of_pow_lt
    (L S : ℕ)
    (h : 3 ^ L < 2 ^ S) :
    alpha * L < S

name: EOC.infinitely_many_positive_lifts_of_confined_evPeriodic
statement:
theorem infinitely_many_positive_lifts_of_confined_evPeriodic
    (c : ℝ)
    (d : ℕ → ℕ)
    (j0 L : ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ i, 1 ≤ d i)
    (hL : 1 ≤ L)
    (hper : EvPeriodic d j0 L)
    (hconf : ∀ N, Confined c d N) :
    ∀ N0,
      ∃ N,
        N0 ≤ N
          ∧ leastRealizer d N
              < leastRealizer d (N + 1)

name: EOC.leastRealizer_unbounded_of_confined_evPeriodic
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_unbounded_of_confined_evPeriodic
    (c : ℝ)
    (d : ℕ → ℕ)
    (j0 L : ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ i, 1 ≤ d i)
    (hL : 1 ≤ L)
    (hper : EvPeriodic d j0 L)
    (hconf : ∀ N, Confined c d N) :
    ∀ M, ∃ N, M < leastRealizer d N

name: EOC.not_confined_forever_of_evPeriodic_orbit
statement:
theorem not_confined_forever_of_evPeriodic_orbit
    (c : ℝ)
    (m0 j0 L : ℕ)
    (hm0 : Odd m0)
    (hL : 1 ≤ L)
    (hper : EvPeriodic (fun i => a (orbit m0 i)) j0 L) :
    ∃ N, ¬ Confined c (fun i => a (orbit m0 i)) N

name: EOC.orbit_add
statement:
theorem orbit_add (m0 j : ℕ) :
    ∀ i, orbit m0 (j + i) = orbit (orbit m0 j) i

name: EOC.orbit_block_identity
statement:
theorem orbit_block_identity (m0 j L : ℕ) :
    2 ^ s (fun i => a (orbit m0 (j + i))) L * orbit m0 (j + L)
      =
    3 ^ L * orbit m0 j
      + q (fun i => a (orbit m0 (j + i))) L

name: EOC.q_eq_qr
statement: theorem q_eq_qr (d : ℕ → ℕ) : ∀ j, q d j = qr d j

name: EOC.realizes_all_of_leastRealizer_const
statement:
theorem realizes_all_of_leastRealizer_const
    (d : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ i, 1 ≤ d i)
    (N0 : ℕ)
    (hN0 : 1 ≤ N0)
    (m : ℕ)
    (hconst : ∀ N, N0 ≤ N → leastRealizer d N = m) :
    ∀ j, a (orbit m j) = d j

name: EOC.s_eq_sr
statement: theorem s_eq_sr (d : ℕ → ℕ) : ∀ j, s d j = sr d j

name: EOC.three_pow_lt_two_pow_of_evPeriodic_orbit
statement:
theorem three_pow_lt_two_pow_of_evPeriodic_orbit
    (m0 j0 L : ℕ)
    (hm0 : Odd m0)
    (hL : 1 ≤ L)
    (hper : EvPeriodic (fun i => a (orbit m0 i)) j0 L) :
    3 ^ L <
      2 ^ blockSum (fun i => a (orbit m0 i)) j0 L

name: EOC.two_pow_a_dvd
statement: theorem two_pow_a_dvd (m : ℕ) : 2 ^ a m ∣ 3 * m + 1

name: EOC.evPeriodic_of_noninj
statement:
theorem evPeriodic_of_noninj (m0 i j : ℕ) (hij : i < j) (heq : orbit m0 i = orbit m0 j) :
    EvPeriodic (fun n => a (orbit m0 n)) i (j - i)

name: EOC.injective_orbit_no_lower_drift
statement:
theorem injective_orbit_no_lower_drift (m0 : ℕ) (hm0 : Odd m0) (Gn : ℕ)
    (hinj : ∀ i j, orbit m0 i = orbit m0 j → i = j)
    (hlow : ∀ j, 3 ^ j ≤ 2 ^ Gn * 2 ^ s (fun n => a (orbit m0 n)) j) : False

name: EOC.leastRealizer_unbounded_of_int_drift
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_unbounded_of_int_drift (c : ℝ) (Gn : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℕ) (hd : ∀ i, 1 ≤ d i)
    (hup : ∀ N, R d N ≤ c) (hlow : ∀ j, 3 ^ j ≤ 2 ^ Gn * 2 ^ s d j) :
    ∀ M, ∃ N, M < leastRealizer d N

name: EOC.leastRealizer_unbounded_of_two_sided_drift
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_unbounded_of_two_sided_drift (c G : ℝ) (d : ℕ → ℕ) (hd : ∀ i, 1 ≤ d i)
    (hup : ∀ N, R d N ≤ c) (hlow : ∀ N, -G ≤ R d N) :
    ∀ M, ∃ N, M < leastRealizer d N

name: EOC.noninjective_orbit_not_upper_confined
statement:
theorem noninjective_orbit_not_upper_confined (c : ℝ) (m0 : ℕ) (hm0 : Odd m0)

name: EOC.PairValuation.leastRealizer_pair_factorization
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_pair_factorization (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (N M k : ℕ) (hkN : k < N) (hkM : k < M)
    (hd_pos : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (he_pos : ∀ i < M, 1 ≤ e i)
    (hagree : ∀ i < k, d i = e i) (hne : d k ≠ e k) :
    ∃ Q : ℤ, Odd Q ∧
      (leastRealizer e M : ℤ) - leastRealizer d N = 2 ^ (S d k + min (d k) (e k)) * Q ∧
      (3 : ℤ) ^ (k + 1) * Q
        = 2 ^ (e k - min (d k) (e k)) * (orbit (leastRealizer e M) (k + 1) : ℤ)
          - 2 ^ (d k - min (d k) (e k)) * (orbit (leastRealizer d N) (k + 1) : ℤ)

name: EOC.PairValuation.leastRealizer_pair_quotient_valuation
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_pair_quotient_valuation (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (N M k : ℕ) (hkN : k < N)
    (hkM : k < M) (hd_pos : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (he_pos : ∀ i < M, 1 ≤ e i)
    (hagree : ∀ i < k, d i = e i) (hne : d k ≠ e k) :
    (2 : ℤ) ^ (S d k + 1) ∣ ((leastRealizer e M : ℤ) - leastRealizer d N) ∧
    padicValInt 2 (((leastRealizer e M : ℤ) - leastRealizer d N) / 2 ^ (S d k + 1))
      = min (d k) (e k) - 1

name: EOC.PairValuation.leastRealizer_pair_valuation
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_pair_valuation (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (N M k : ℕ) (hkN : k < N) (hkM : k < M)

    (hagree : ∀ i < k, d i = e i) (hne : d k ≠ e k) :
    padicValInt 2 ((leastRealizer e M : ℤ) - leastRealizer d N) = S d k + min (d k) (e k)

name: EOC.PairValuation.orbit_carry
statement:
theorem orbit_carry (x j : ℕ) :

name: EOC.PairValuation.orbit_pair_carry_identity
statement:
theorem orbit_pair_carry_identity (x x' k : ℕ)
    (hagree : ∀ j < k, a (orbit x j) = a (orbit x' j)) :
    (3 : ℤ) ^ (k + 1) * ((x' : ℤ) - x)
      = 2 ^ s (fun i => a (orbit x i)) k
        * (2 ^ a (orbit x' k) * (orbit x' (k + 1) : ℤ)
          - 2 ^ a (orbit x k) * (orbit x (k + 1) : ℤ))

name: EOC.PairValuation.orbit_pair_factorization
statement:
theorem orbit_pair_factorization (x x' k : ℕ)
    (hagree : ∀ j < k, a (orbit x j) = a (orbit x' j))
    (hne : a (orbit x k) ≠ a (orbit x' k)) :
    ∃ Q : ℤ, Odd Q ∧
      (x' : ℤ) - x
        = 2 ^ (s (fun i => a (orbit x i)) k + min (a (orbit x k)) (a (orbit x' k))) * Q ∧
      (3 : ℤ) ^ (k + 1) * Q
        = 2 ^ (a (orbit x' k) - min (a (orbit x k)) (a (orbit x' k))) * (orbit x' (k + 1) : ℤ)
          - 2 ^ (a (orbit x k) - min (a (orbit x k)) (a (orbit x' k)))
            * (orbit x (k + 1) : ℤ)

name: EOC.PairValuation.orbit_pair_valuation
statement:
theorem orbit_pair_valuation (x x' k : ℕ)
    (hagree : ∀ j < k, a (orbit x j) = a (orbit x' j))
    (hne : a (orbit x k) ≠ a (orbit x' k)) :
    padicValInt 2 ((x' : ℤ) - x)
      = s (fun i => a (orbit x i)) k + min (a (orbit x k)) (a (orbit x' k))

theorem modEq_leastRealizer_of_realizes {d : ℕ → ℕ} {N y : ℕ} (hy : Realizes d N y) :
    y ≡ leastRealizer d N [MOD 2 ^ (S d N + 1)]

name: EOC.SuffixTransport.mod_eq_leastRealizer_of_realizes
statement:
theorem mod_eq_leastRealizer_of_realizes {d : ℕ → ℕ} {N y : ℕ} (hy : Realizes d N y) :
    y % 2 ^ (S d N + 1) = leastRealizer d N

name: EOC.SuffixTransport.pair_split_depth_shift
statement:
theorem pair_split_depth_shift (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (k t x x' : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ k)
    (hx : Realizes d (k + 1) x) (hx' : Realizes e (k + 1) x')
    (hagree : ∀ i < k, d i = e i) (hne : d k ≠ e k) :
    padicValInt 2 ((orbit x' t : ℤ) - orbit x t) = (S d k - S d t) + min (d k) (e k)

name: EOC.SuffixTransport.pair_suffix_cofactor
statement:
theorem pair_suffix_cofactor (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (N M k : ℕ) (hkN : k < N) (hkM : k < M)
    (hd_pos : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (he_pos : ∀ i < M, 1 ≤ e i)
    (hagree : ∀ i < k, d i = e i) (hne : d k ≠ e k) :
    ∃ Q : ℤ, Odd Q ∧
      (leastRealizer e M : ℤ) - leastRealizer d N = 2 ^ (S d k + min (d k) (e k)) * Q ∧
      (3 : ℤ) ^ (k + 1) * Q ≡
        2 ^ (e k - min (d k) (e k)) * (leastRealizer (shiftWord e (k + 1)) (M - (k + 1)) : ℤ)
          - 2 ^ (d k - min (d k) (e k)) * (leastRealizer (shiftWord d (k + 1)) (N - (k + 1)) : ℤ)
        [ZMOD 2 ^ (min (S d N) (S e M) - (S d k + min (d k) (e k)) + 1)]

name: EOC.SuffixTransport.realizes_carry
statement:
theorem realizes_carry {d : ℕ → ℕ} {N x : ℕ} (h : Realizes d N x) {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ N) :
    2 ^ S d t * orbit x t = 3 ^ t * x + q d t

name: EOC.SuffixTransport.realizes_pos
statement: theorem realizes_pos {d : ℕ → ℕ} {N y : ℕ} (hy : Realizes d N y) : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i

name: EOC.SuffixTransport.realizes_shiftWord
statement:
theorem realizes_shiftWord {d : ℕ → ℕ} {N t x : ℕ} (h : Realizes d N x) (ht : t ≤ N) :
    Realizes (shiftWord d t) (N - t) (orbit x t)

name: EOC.SuffixTransport.s_add_shiftWord
statement:
theorem s_add_shiftWord (d : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) :
    ∀ n, s d (t + n) = s d t + s (shiftWord d t) n

name: EOC.SuffixTransport.suffix_transport
statement:
theorem suffix_transport {d : ℕ → ℕ} {N t x : ℕ} (hx : Realizes d N x) (ht : t ≤ N) :
    orbit x t ≡ leastRealizer (shiftWord d t) (N - t) [MOD 2 ^ (S d N - S d t + 1)]

name: EOC.SuffixTransport.suffix_transport_structure
statement:
theorem suffix_transport_structure {d : ℕ → ℕ} {N t x : ℕ} (hx : Realizes d N x) (ht : t ≤ N) :
    2 ^ S d t * orbit x t = 3 ^ t * x + q d t ∧
    orbit x t = leastRealizer (shiftWord d t) (N - t)
      + 2 ^ (S d N - S d t + 1) * (orbit x t / 2 ^ (S d N - S d t + 1))

name: EOC.TransportCollapse.anchorState_spec
statement:
theorem anchorState_spec (d : ℕ → ℕ) (j : ℕ) :
    2 ^ S d j * anchorState d j = 3 ^ j * chi d j + q d j

name: EOC.TransportCollapse.carry_pair_factorization
statement:
theorem carry_pair_factorization (e e' : ℕ → ℕ) (m : ℕ)
    (hagree : ∀ i < m, e i = e' i) (hne : e m ≠ e' m) :
    ∀ t, (∀ i < m + 2 + t, 1 ≤ e i) → (∀ i < m + 2 + t, 1 ≤ e' i) →
      ∃ Q : ℤ, Odd Q ∧
        (q e (m + 2 + t) : ℤ) - q e' (m + 2 + t) = 2 ^ (S e m + min (e m) (e' m)) * Q

name: EOC.TransportCollapse.carry_pair_valuation
statement:
theorem carry_pair_valuation (e e' : ℕ → ℕ) (m L : ℕ) (hL : m + 2 ≤ L)
    (hagree : ∀ i < m, e i = e' i) (hne : e m ≠ e' m)
    (hpos : ∀ i < L, 1 ≤ e i) (hpos' : ∀ i < L, 1 ≤ e' i) :
    padicValInt 2 ((q e L : ℤ) - q e' L) = S e m + min (e m) (e' m)

name: EOC.TransportCollapse.chi_add_eq_iff
statement:
theorem chi_add_eq_iff {d : ℕ → ℕ} {j m n : ℕ} (h : Realizes d (j + m) n) :
    chi d (j + m) = chi d j ↔ 2 ^ (S d (j + m) - S d j) ∣ n / 2 ^ S d j

name: EOC.TransportCollapse.chi_eq_mod
statement:
theorem chi_eq_mod {d : ℕ → ℕ} {j n : ℕ} (h : Realizes d j n) :
    chi d j = n % 2 ^ S d j

name: EOC.TransportCollapse.chi_succ_eq
statement:
theorem chi_succ_eq {d : ℕ → ℕ} {j n : ℕ} (h : Realizes d (j + 1) n) :
    chi d (j + 1) = chi d j + 2 ^ S d j * (n / 2 ^ S d j % 2 ^ d j)

name: EOC.TransportCollapse.div_two_pow_mod_two
statement:
theorem div_two_pow_mod_two {d : ℕ → ℕ} {j n : ℕ} (h : Realizes d j n) :
    n / 2 ^ S d j % 2 = leastRealizer d j / 2 ^ S d j

name: EOC.TransportCollapse.high_matching_iff
statement:
theorem high_matching_iff {d : ℕ → ℕ} {j n : ℕ} (h : Realizes d j n) (M : ℕ) :
    2 ^ M ∣ n / 2 ^ S d j ↔ n % 2 ^ (S d j + M) = chi d j

name: EOC.TransportCollapse.matching_eq_pair_split
statement:
theorem matching_eq_pair_split {d : ℕ → ℕ} {j m n : ℕ} (hn : Realizes d j n)
    (hβ : leastRealizer d j < 2 ^ S d j)
    (hagree : ∀ i < j + m, a (orbit (leastRealizer d j) i) = a (orbit n i))
    (hne : a (orbit (leastRealizer d j) (j + m)) ≠ a (orbit n (j + m))) :
    padicValInt 2 ((n / 2 ^ S d j : ℕ) : ℤ) + S d j
      = s (fun i => a (orbit (leastRealizer d j) i)) (j + m)
        + min (a (orbit (leastRealizer d j) (j + m))) (a (orbit n (j + m)))

name: EOC.TransportCollapse.mod_split
statement:
theorem mod_split {d : ℕ → ℕ} {j n : ℕ} (h : Realizes d j n) (B : ℕ) :
    n % 2 ^ (S d j + B) = chi d j + 2 ^ S d j * (n / 2 ^ S d j % 2 ^ B)

name: EOC.TransportCollapse.orbit_eq_anchorState_add
statement:
theorem orbit_eq_anchorState_add {d : ℕ → ℕ} {j n : ℕ} (h : Realizes d j n) :
    orbit n j = anchorState d j + 3 ^ j * (n / 2 ^ S d j)

name: EOC.TransportCollapse.two_dvd_div_iff
statement:
theorem two_dvd_div_iff {d : ℕ → ℕ} {j n : ℕ} (h : Realizes d j n) :
    2 ∣ n / 2 ^ S d j ↔ leastRealizer d j < 2 ^ S d j

name: EOC.TransportCollapse.two_pow_dvd_carry
statement:
theorem two_pow_dvd_carry {d : ℕ → ℕ} {j n : ℕ} (h : Realizes d j n) :
    2 ^ S d j ∣ 3 ^ j * n + q d j

name: EOC.PrescribedMatching.anchor_exits_corridor
statement:
theorem anchor_exits_corridor (d : ℕ → ℕ) (j : ℕ) (hodd : Odd (anchorState d j)) (c G : ℝ) :
    ¬ (∀ N, R (anchorWord d j) N ≤ c ∧ -G ≤ R (anchorWord d j) N)

name: EOC.PrescribedMatching.confined_prescribed_matching_le
statement:
theorem confined_prescribed_matching_le (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (j m L : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hLm : L + 1 ≤ m)
    (he : ∀ i < m, 1 ≤ e i) (hconf : Confined c e m)
    (hviol : c < R (anchorWord d j) (L + 1)) :
    ((padicValInt 2 ((leastRealizer e m : ℤ) - anchorState d j) : ℕ) : ℝ)
      ≤ c + ((L + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * alpha

name: EOC.PrescribedMatching.corridor_prescribed_diverges
statement:
theorem corridor_prescribed_diverges (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (j : ℕ) (hodd : Odd (anchorState d j))
    (c G : ℝ) (he : ∀ N, R e N ≤ c ∧ -G ≤ R e N) :
    ∃ i, anchorWord d j i ≠ e i

name: EOC.PrescribedMatching.prescribed_full_match_iff
statement:
theorem prescribed_full_match_iff (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (j m : ℕ) (he : ∀ i < m, 1 ≤ e i)
    (hodd : Odd (anchorState d j)) :
    leastRealizer e m ≡ anchorState d j [MOD 2 ^ (S e m + 1)]
      ↔ ∀ i < m, anchorWord d j i = e i

name: EOC.PrescribedMatching.prescribed_matching_split
statement:
theorem prescribed_matching_split (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (j m k : ℕ) (hk : k < m)
    (he : ∀ i < m, 1 ≤ e i)
    (hagree : ∀ i < k, anchorWord d j i = e i) (hne : anchorWord d j k ≠ e k) :
    padicValInt 2 ((leastRealizer e m : ℤ) - anchorState d j)
      = S e k + min (anchorWord d j k) (e k)

name: EOC.PrescribedMatching.shadow_injective_floor_bound
statement:
theorem shadow_injective_floor_bound (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (j L g : ℕ) (hL : 1 ≤ L)
    (hodd : Odd (anchorState d j))
    (hagree : ∀ i < 2 ^ L, anchorWord d j i = e i)
    (hinj : ∀ i ≤ 2 ^ L, ∀ i' ≤ 2 ^ L,
      orbit (anchorState d j) i = orbit (anchorState d j) i' → i = i')
    (hlow : ∀ t ≤ 2 ^ L, -((g : ℝ)) ≤ R e t) :
    2 ^ (2 * (L + 1)) ≤ 2 ^ g * anchorState d j * 3 ^ (L + 1)

name: EOC.LogCorridor.exits_logCorridor
statement:
theorem exits_logCorridor (M : ℕ) (hM : Odd M) (B C U : ℝ) (hB : B < 8 / 9) :
    ¬ ∀ n, InLogCorridor B C U (orbWord M) n

name: EOC.LogCorridor.exits_logCorridor_of_exclusion
statement:
theorem exits_logCorridor_of_exclusion {Bstar : ℝ} (hX : LogFloorExclusion Bstar)
    (M : ℕ) (hM : Odd M) (B C U : ℝ) (hB : B < Bstar) :
    ¬ ∀ n, InLogCorridor B C U (orbWord M) n

name: EOC.LogCorridor.logCorridor_matching_le_exit
statement:
theorem logCorridor_matching_le_exit (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (j m L : ℕ) (B C U : ℝ) (hLm : L ≤ m)
    (he_pos : ∀ i < m, 1 ≤ e i) (he : ∀ n ≤ m, InLogCorridor B C U e n)
    (hexit : ¬ InLogCorridor B C U (anchorWord d j) L) :
    ((padicValInt 2 ((leastRealizer e m : ℤ) - anchorState d j) : ℕ) : ℝ)
      ≤ U + (L : ℝ) * alpha

name: EOC.LogCorridor.logCorridor_prescribed_diverges
statement:
theorem logCorridor_prescribed_diverges (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (j : ℕ) (hodd : Odd (anchorState d j))
    (B C U : ℝ) (hB : B < 8 / 9) (he : ∀ n, InLogCorridor B C U e n) :
    ∃ i, anchorWord d j i ≠ e i

name: EOC.LogCorridor.logCorridor_prescribed_diverges_of_exclusion
statement:
theorem logCorridor_prescribed_diverges_of_exclusion {Bstar : ℝ} (hX : LogFloorExclusion Bstar)
    (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (j : ℕ) (hodd : Odd (anchorState d j)) (B C U : ℝ) (hB : B < Bstar)
    (he : ∀ n, InLogCorridor B C U e n) :
    ∃ i, anchorWord d j i ≠ e i

name: EOC.LogCorridor.logCorridor_shadow_window_bound
statement:
theorem logCorridor_shadow_window_bound (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (j N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hodd : Odd (anchorState d j)) (hagree : ∀ i < N, anchorWord d j i = e i)
    (hinj : ∀ i < N, ∀ i' < N, orbit (anchorState d j) i = orbit (anchorState d j) i' → i = i')
    (B C : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hfloor : ∀ k < N, -B * Real.logb 2 ((k : ℝ) + 1) - C ≤ R e k) :
    (N : ℝ) ^ ((8 : ℝ) / 9 - B) ≤ 3 * Real.exp (7 / 9) * (2 : ℝ) ^ C * (anchorState d j : ℝ)

name: EOC.LogCorridor.logFloorExclusion_eight_ninths
statement: theorem logFloorExclusion_eight_ninths : LogFloorExclusion (8 / 9)

name: EOC.LogCorridor.logFloor_window_bound
statement:
theorem logFloor_window_bound (M N : ℕ) (hM : Odd M) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hinj : ∀ i < N, ∀ j < N, orbit M i = orbit M j → i = j)
    (B C : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hfloor : ∀ k < N, -B * Real.logb 2 ((k : ℝ) + 1) - C ≤ R (orbWord M) k) :
    (N : ℝ) * ((N : ℝ) ^ (-B) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-C))
      ≤ 3 * (M : ℝ) * (Real.exp (7 / 9) * (N : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9))

name: EOC.LogCorridor.logFloor_window_bound'
statement:
theorem logFloor_window_bound' (M N : ℕ) (hM : Odd M) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hinj : ∀ i < N, ∀ j < N, orbit M i = orbit M j → i = j)
    (B C : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hfloor : ∀ k < N, -B * Real.logb 2 ((k : ℝ) + 1) - C ≤ R (orbWord M) k) :
    (N : ℝ) ^ ((8 : ℝ) / 9 - B) ≤ 3 * Real.exp (7 / 9) * (2 : ℝ) ^ C * (M : ℝ)

name: EOC.LogCorridor.matching_le_of_R_ne
statement:
theorem matching_le_of_R_ne (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (j m L : ℕ) (U : ℝ) (hLm : L ≤ m)
    (he_pos : ∀ i < m, 1 ≤ e i) (hU : ∀ n ≤ m, R e n ≤ U)
    (hne : R e L ≠ R (anchorWord d j) L) :
    ((padicValInt 2 ((leastRealizer e m : ℤ) - anchorState d j) : ℕ) : ℝ)
      ≤ U + (L : ℝ) * alpha

name: EOC.UpperEscape.R_after_one
statement:
theorem R_after_one (m0 h : ℕ) (hh : orbit m0 h = 1) (t : ℕ) :
    R (orbWord m0) (h + t) = R (orbWord m0) h + (t : ℝ) * (2 - alpha)

name: EOC.UpperEscape.R_gt_iff
statement:
theorem R_gt_iff (M n : ℕ) (hM : Odd M) (c : ℝ) :
    c < R (orbWord M) n ↔ (2 : ℝ) ^ c * (orbit M n : ℝ) < (M : ℝ) * carryU M n

name: EOC.UpperEscape.R_zero
statement: theorem R_zero (d : ℕ → ℕ) : R d 0 = 0

name: EOC.UpperEscape.T_one
statement: theorem T_one : T 1 = 1

name: EOC.UpperEscape.a_one
statement: theorem a_one : a 1 = 2

name: EOC.UpperEscape.bounded_orbit_not_injective
statement:
theorem bounded_orbit_not_injective (M K : ℕ) (hb : ∀ n, orbit M n ≤ K) :
    ∃ i j, i ≠ j ∧ orbit M i = orbit M j

name: EOC.UpperEscape.bounded_orbit_not_upper_confined
statement:
theorem bounded_orbit_not_upper_confined (M K : ℕ) (hM : Odd M) (hb : ∀ n, orbit M n ≤ K)
    (c : ℝ) : ∃ N, ¬ Confined c (orbWord M) N

name: EOC.UpperEscape.carryU_mono
statement: theorem carryU_mono (M t : ℕ) : ∀ k, carryU M t ≤ carryU M (t + k)

name: EOC.UpperEscape.cycle_gain_pos
statement:
theorem cycle_gain_pos (m0 j0 L : ℕ) (hm0 : Odd m0) (hL : 1 ≤ L)
    (hper : EvPeriodic (orbWord m0) j0 L) :
    0 < (blockSum (orbWord m0) j0 L : ℝ) - alpha * L

name: EOC.UpperEscape.descent_prescribed_matching_le
statement:
theorem descent_prescribed_matching_le (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (j m L : ℕ) (U : ℝ) (hLm : L ≤ m)
    (he_pos : ∀ i < m, 1 ≤ e i) (hU : ∀ n ≤ m, R e n ≤ U) (hodd : Odd (anchorState d j))
    (hdesc : (2 : ℝ) ^ U * (orbit (anchorState d j) L : ℝ) < (anchorState d j : ℝ)) :
    ((padicValInt 2 ((leastRealizer e m : ℤ) - anchorState d j) : ℕ) : ℝ)
      ≤ U + (L : ℝ) * alpha

name: EOC.UpperEscape.evPeriodic_orbit_exit
statement:
theorem evPeriodic_orbit_exit (m0 j0 L : ℕ) (hm0 : Odd m0) (hL : 1 ≤ L)
    (hper : EvPeriodic (orbWord m0) j0 L) (c : ℝ) :
    c < R (orbWord m0)
      (j0 + (Nat.ceil ((c - R (orbWord m0) j0)
        / ((blockSum (orbWord m0) j0 L : ℝ) - alpha * L)) + 1) * L)

name: EOC.UpperEscape.evPeriodic_orbit_exit_at
statement:
theorem evPeriodic_orbit_exit_at (m0 j0 L : ℕ) (hper : EvPeriodic (orbWord m0) j0 L) (c : ℝ)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : c - R (orbWord m0) j0
      < (k : ℝ) * ((blockSum (orbWord m0) j0 L : ℝ) - alpha * L)) :
    c < R (orbWord m0) (j0 + k * L)

name: EOC.UpperEscape.exceptional_class
statement:
theorem exceptional_class (M : ℕ) (hM : Odd M) (U : ℝ) (hE : UpperConfinedForever U M) :
    (∀ i j, orbit M i = orbit M j → i = j) ∧
    (∀ K, ∃ N₀, ∀ n ≥ N₀, K < orbit M n) ∧
    (∀ n, (M : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ U * (orbit M n : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ B < (8 : ℝ) / 9, ∀ K : ℝ, ∀ N₀ : ℕ, ∃ n ≥ N₀,
      R (orbWord M) n < -B * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ) - K)

name: EOC.UpperEscape.exceptional_class_of_exclusion
statement:
theorem exceptional_class_of_exclusion {Bstar : ℝ} (hX : LogFloorExclusion Bstar)
    (M : ℕ) (hM : Odd M) (U : ℝ) (hE : UpperConfinedForever U M) :
    (∀ i j, orbit M i = orbit M j → i = j) ∧
    (∀ K, ∃ N₀, ∀ n ≥ N₀, K < orbit M n) ∧
    (∀ n, (M : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ U * (orbit M n : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ B < Bstar, ∀ K : ℝ, ∀ N₀ : ℕ, ∃ n ≥ N₀,
      R (orbWord M) n < -B * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ) - K)

name: EOC.UpperEscape.injective_orbit_tendsto
statement:
theorem injective_orbit_tendsto (M : ℕ) (hinj : ∀ i j, orbit M i = orbit M j → i = j) (K : ℕ) :
    ∃ N₀, ∀ n ≥ N₀, K < orbit M n

name: EOC.UpperEscape.orbit_dichotomy
statement:
theorem orbit_dichotomy (M : ℕ) :
    (∀ i j, orbit M i = orbit M j → i = j) ∨
      ∃ j0 L, 1 ≤ L ∧ EvPeriodic (orbWord M) j0 L

name: EOC.UpperEscape.orbit_mul_two_rpow_R_mono
statement:
theorem orbit_mul_two_rpow_R_mono (M t t' : ℕ) (hM : Odd M) (h : t ≤ t') :
    (orbit M t : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ R (orbWord M) t
      ≤ (orbit M t' : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ R (orbWord M) t'

name: EOC.UpperEscape.orbit_one
statement: theorem orbit_one (t : ℕ) : orbit 1 t = 1

name: EOC.UpperEscape.reach_one_prescribed_matching_le
statement:
theorem reach_one_prescribed_matching_le (d e : ℕ → ℕ) (j m h : ℕ) (U : ℝ) (hhm : h ≤ m)
    (he_pos : ∀ i < m, 1 ≤ e i) (hU : ∀ n ≤ m, R e n ≤ U) (hodd : Odd (anchorState d j))
    (hh : orbit (anchorState d j) h = 1) (hbig : (2 : ℝ) ^ U < (anchorState d j : ℝ)) :
    ((padicValInt 2 ((leastRealizer e m : ℤ) - anchorState d j) : ℕ) : ℝ)
      ≤ U + (h : ℝ) * alpha

name: EOC.UpperEscape.reach_one_upper_exit
statement:
theorem reach_one_upper_exit (m0 h : ℕ) (hm0 : Odd m0) (hh : orbit m0 h = 1) (c : ℝ) :
    (∀ t : ℕ, c - R (orbWord m0) h < (t : ℝ) * (2 - alpha) → c < R (orbWord m0) (h + t)) ∧
    ((2 : ℝ) ^ c < (m0 : ℝ) → c < R (orbWord m0) h)

name: EOC.UpperEscape.rebased_upper_log_wall
statement:
theorem rebased_upper_log_wall (M : ℕ) (hM : Odd M)
    (hinj : ∀ i j, orbit M i = orbit M j → i = j) :
    ∃ n₀, ∀ n,
      R (orbWord (orbit M n₀)) n ≤ (1 / 9) * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ) + 7 / (9 * Real.log 2)

name: EOC.UpperEscape.seed_le_orbit_mul_two_rpow_R
statement:
theorem seed_le_orbit_mul_two_rpow_R (M n : ℕ) (hM : Odd M) :
    (M : ℝ) ≤ (orbit M n : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ R (orbWord M) n

name: EOC.UpperEscape.two_rpow_R_at_one
statement:
theorem two_rpow_R_at_one (m0 h : ℕ) (hm0 : Odd m0) (hh : orbit m0 h = 1) :
    (m0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ R (orbWord m0) h

name: EOC.UpperEscape.upper_exit_of_descent
statement:
theorem upper_exit_of_descent (M n : ℕ) (hM : Odd M) (c : ℝ)
    (h : (2 : ℝ) ^ c * (orbit M n : ℝ) < (M : ℝ)) : c < R (orbWord M) n

name: EOC.UpperEscape.window_drift_gain
statement:
theorem window_drift_gain (M t t' : ℕ) (hM : Odd M) (h : t ≤ t') :
    (orbit M t : ℝ) ≤ (orbit M t' : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (R (orbWord M) t' - R (orbWord M) t)

name: EOC.UpperEscape.word_after_one
statement: theorem word_after_one (m0 h : ℕ) (hh : orbit m0 h = 1) (t : ℕ) : orbWord m0 (h + t) = 2

name: EOC.UpperCertificates.R_add_block
statement:
theorem R_add_block (d : ℕ → ℕ) (t ℓ : ℕ) :
    R d (t + ℓ) = R d t + (((s d (t + ℓ) : ℝ) - s d t) - (ℓ : ℝ) * alpha)

name: EOC.UpperCertificates.block_certificate
statement:
theorem block_certificate (d : ℕ → ℕ) (t ℓ : ℕ) (U : ℝ)
    (h : U - R d t < ((s d (t + ℓ) : ℝ) - s d t) - (ℓ : ℝ) * alpha) :
    U < R d (t + ℓ)

name: EOC.UpperCertificates.contraction_drift_gain
statement:
theorem contraction_drift_gain (M t t' : ℕ) (hM : Odd M) (htt' : t ≤ t') (H : ℝ)
    (h : (2 : ℝ) ^ H * (orbit M t' : ℝ) < (orbit M t : ℝ)) :
    H < R (orbWord M) t' - R (orbWord M) t

name: EOC.UpperCertificates.divergence_iff_upperLogAnchor
statement:
theorem divergence_iff_upperLogAnchor :
    (∃ M, Odd M ∧ ∀ i j, orbit M i = orbit M j → i = j) ↔
      ∃ μ, Odd μ ∧ ∀ n, R (orbWord μ) n ≤ (1 / 9) * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ) + 7 / (9 * Real.log 2)

name: EOC.UpperCertificates.exceptional_headroom_unbounded
statement:
theorem exceptional_headroom_unbounded (M : ℕ) (hM : Odd M) (U : ℝ)
    (hE : UpperConfinedForever U M) (H : ℝ) (N₀ : ℕ) :
    ∃ t ≥ N₀, H < U - R (orbWord M) t

name: EOC.UpperCertificates.exceptional_window
statement:
theorem exceptional_window (M : ℕ) (U : ℝ) (hE : UpperConfinedForever U M) (t ℓ : ℕ) :
    ((s (orbWord M) (t + ℓ) : ℝ) - s (orbWord M) t)
      ≤ (ℓ : ℝ) * alpha + (U - R (orbWord M) t)

name: EOC.UpperCertificates.injective_of_sublinear_upper_wall
statement:
theorem injective_of_sublinear_upper_wall (M : ℕ) (hM : Odd M) (W : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hW : SublinearWall W) (hup : ∀ n, R (orbWord M) n ≤ W n) :
    ∀ i j, orbit M i = orbit M j → i = j

name: EOC.UpperCertificates.logWall_sublinear
statement: theorem logWall_sublinear (a C : ℝ) : SublinearWall (fun n => a * Real.logb 2 n + C)

name: EOC.UpperCertificates.run_certificate
statement:
theorem run_certificate (d : ℕ → ℕ) (t r q : ℕ) (U : ℝ)
    (hones : ∀ i < r, d (t + i) = 1) (hq : d (t + r) = q)
    (h : (U - R d t) + ((r : ℝ) + 1) * alpha - r < q) :
    U < R d (t + (r + 1))

name: EOC.SurvivorCounting.card_realizers_eq_of_dvd
statement:
theorem card_realizers_eq_of_dvd (d : ℕ → ℕ) (N X : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hd_pos : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i)
    [DecidablePred (fun μ => Realizes d N μ)] (hdvd : 2 ^ (S d N + 1) ∣ X) :
    ((range X).filter (fun μ => Realizes d N μ)).card = X / 2 ^ (S d N + 1)

name: EOC.SurvivorCounting.card_realizers_le
statement:
theorem card_realizers_le (d : ℕ → ℕ) (N X : ℕ) [DecidablePred (fun μ => Realizes d N μ)] :
    ((range X).filter (fun μ => Realizes d N μ)).card ≤ X / 2 ^ (S d N + 1) + 1

name: EOC.SurvivorCounting.card_seeds_le_sum
statement:
theorem card_seeds_le_sum (N X : ℕ) (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (W : Finset (FiniteValuationWord N))
    (hW : ∀ μ < X, Odd μ → P μ → prefixWord N μ ∈ W) :
    ((range X).filter (fun μ => Odd μ ∧ P μ)).card
      ≤ ∑ w ∈ W, (X / 2 ^ (S (FiniteValuationWord.toInfinite w) N + 1) + 1)

name: EOC.SurvivorCounting.realizes_prefixWord
statement:
theorem realizes_prefixWord (N μ : ℕ) (hμ : Odd μ) :
    Realizes (FiniteValuationWord.toInfinite (prefixWord N μ)) N μ

name: EOC.harmonic_ap_discrepancy
statement:
theorem harmonic_ap_discrepancy (M : ℕ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (k0 u N : ℕ) (A0 D : ℝ)
    (hA0 : 0 < A0) (hD : 0 ≤ D) :
    |∑ j ∈ range N, (if (k0 + j) % M = u % M then (1 : ℝ) / (A0 + D * j) else 0)
        - (1 / (M : ℝ)) * ∑ j ∈ range N, (1 : ℝ) / (A0 + D * j)| ≤ 1 / A0

name: EOC.residue_count_discrepancy
statement:
theorem residue_count_discrepancy (M : ℕ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (k0 u N : ℕ) :
    |(((range N).filter (fun j => (k0 + j) % M = u % M)).card : ℝ)
        - (N : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)| ≤ (1 : ℝ)

name: EOC.weighted_residue_discrepancy
statement:
theorem weighted_residue_discrepancy (c g : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ)
    (hbound : ∀ n ≤ N, |∑ j ∈ range n, c j| ≤ 1)
    (hg0 : 0 ≤ g 0)
    (hg_nonneg : ∀ j < N, 0 ≤ g j)
    (hg_anti : ∀ i, i + 1 < N → g (i + 1) ≤ g i) :
    |∑ j ∈ range N, c j * g j| ≤ g 0

name: EOC.conditional_residue_tv_eta_bound
statement:
theorem conditional_residue_tv_eta_bound
    (d : ℕ → ℕ) (t r : ℕ) (h : Realizes d t r) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (Q : ℕ) (hQ : 1 ≤ Q) (Y H : ℕ) (hYr : r ≤ Y) (hYpos : 0 < Y) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hH : η * (Y : ℝ) ≤ (H : ℝ))
    (hthick : 4 * (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) ≤ η * (Y : ℝ)) :
    ∃ kmin N : ℕ, ∃ W : ℝ, 0 < W ∧
      W = ∑ j ∈ range N, (1 : ℝ) / ((r : ℝ) + (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) * ((kmin : ℝ) + j)) ∧
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ v ∈ oddResidues Q,
          |(∑ j ∈ range N,
              (if orbit (r + 2 ^ (S d t + 1) * (kmin + j)) t % 2 ^ Q = v % 2 ^ Q
                then (1 : ℝ) / ((r : ℝ) + (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) * ((kmin : ℝ) + j)) else 0)) / W
            - 1 / (2 ^ (Q - 1) : ℝ)|
        ≤ (1 + 1 / η) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (Q + S d t) / (Y : ℝ)

name: EOC.conditional_residue_tv_eta_bound_at_window
statement:
theorem conditional_residue_tv_eta_bound_at_window
    (d : ℕ → ℕ) (t r : ℕ) (h : Realizes d t r) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (Q : ℕ) (hQ : 1 ≤ Q) (Y H : ℕ) (hYr : r ≤ Y) (hYpos : 0 < Y) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hH : η * (Y : ℝ) ≤ (H : ℝ))
    (hthick : 4 * (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) ≤ η * (Y : ℝ))
    (kmin N : ℕ)
    (hmem : ∀ j < N, Y ≤ r + 2 ^ (S d t + 1) * (kmin + j)
      ∧ r + 2 ^ (S d t + 1) * (kmin + j) < Y + H)
    (hNlb : ((Y : ℝ) + (H : ℝ)) - (Y : ℝ) ≤ ((N : ℝ) + 2) * (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ)) :
    ∃ W : ℝ, 0 < W ∧
      W = ∑ j ∈ range N, (1 : ℝ) / ((r : ℝ) + (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) * ((kmin : ℝ) + j)) ∧
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ v ∈ oddResidues Q,
          |(∑ j ∈ range N,
              (if orbit (r + 2 ^ (S d t + 1) * (kmin + j)) t % 2 ^ Q = v % 2 ^ Q
                then (1 : ℝ) / ((r : ℝ) + (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) * ((kmin : ℝ) + j)) else 0)) / W
            - 1 / (2 ^ (Q - 1) : ℝ)|
        ≤ (1 + 1 / η) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (Q + S d t) / (Y : ℝ)

name: EOC.conditional_residue_tv_explicit
statement:
theorem conditional_residue_tv_explicit
    (d : ℕ → ℕ) (t r : ℕ) (h : Realizes d t r) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (Q : ℕ) (hQ : 1 ≤ Q) (kmin N : ℕ)
    (W : ℝ) (hW : 0 < W)
    (hWeq : W = ∑ j ∈ range N, (1 : ℝ) / ((r : ℝ) + (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) * ((kmin : ℝ) + j))) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ v ∈ oddResidues Q,
        |(∑ j ∈ range N,
            (if orbit (r + 2 ^ (S d t + 1) * (kmin + j)) t % 2 ^ Q = v % 2 ^ Q
              then (1 : ℝ) / ((r : ℝ) + (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) * ((kmin : ℝ) + j)) else 0)) / W
          - 1 / (2 ^ (Q - 1) : ℝ)|
      ≤ (2 ^ (Q - 1) : ℝ) / (2 * ((r : ℝ) + (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) * (kmin : ℝ)) * W)

name: EOC.conditional_residue_tv_window_bound
statement:
theorem conditional_residue_tv_window_bound
    (d : ℕ → ℕ) (t r : ℕ) (h : Realizes d t r) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (Q : ℕ) (hQ : 1 ≤ Q) (Y H : ℕ) (hYr : r ≤ Y) (hYpos : 0 < Y) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hH : η * (Y : ℝ) ≤ (H : ℝ))
    (hthick : 4 * (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) ≤ η * (Y : ℝ)) :
    ∃ kmin N : ℕ, ∃ W : ℝ, 0 < W ∧
      W = ∑ j ∈ range N, (1 : ℝ) / ((r : ℝ) + (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) * ((kmin : ℝ) + j)) ∧
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ v ∈ oddResidues Q,
          |(∑ j ∈ range N,
              (if orbit (r + 2 ^ (S d t + 1) * (kmin + j)) t % 2 ^ Q = v % 2 ^ Q
                then (1 : ℝ) / ((r : ℝ) + (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) * ((kmin : ℝ) + j)) else 0)) / W
            - 1 / (2 ^ (Q - 1) : ℝ)|
        ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (Q + S d t) * ((Y : ℝ) + (H : ℝ)) / ((Y : ℝ) * (H : ℝ))

name: EOC.conditional_residue_tv_window_bound_at_window
statement:
theorem conditional_residue_tv_window_bound_at_window
    (d : ℕ → ℕ) (t r : ℕ) (h : Realizes d t r) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (Q : ℕ) (hQ : 1 ≤ Q) (Y H : ℕ) (hYr : r ≤ Y) (hYpos : 0 < Y) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hH : η * (Y : ℝ) ≤ (H : ℝ))
    (hthick : 4 * (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) ≤ η * (Y : ℝ))
    (kmin N : ℕ)
    (hmem : ∀ j < N, Y ≤ r + 2 ^ (S d t + 1) * (kmin + j)
      ∧ r + 2 ^ (S d t + 1) * (kmin + j) < Y + H)
    (hNlb : ((Y : ℝ) + (H : ℝ)) - (Y : ℝ) ≤ ((N : ℝ) + 2) * (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ)) :
    ∃ W : ℝ, 0 < W ∧
      W = ∑ j ∈ range N, (1 : ℝ) / ((r : ℝ) + (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) * ((kmin : ℝ) + j)) ∧
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ v ∈ oddResidues Q,
          |(∑ j ∈ range N,
              (if orbit (r + 2 ^ (S d t + 1) * (kmin + j)) t % 2 ^ Q = v % 2 ^ Q
                then (1 : ℝ) / ((r : ℝ) + (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) * ((kmin : ℝ) + j)) else 0)) / W
            - 1 / (2 ^ (Q - 1) : ℝ)|
        ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (Q + S d t) * ((Y : ℝ) + (H : ℝ)) / ((Y : ℝ) * (H : ℝ))

name: EOC.cylinder_count_lower_bound_half
statement:
theorem cylinder_count_lower_bound_half (D N : ℕ) (H : ℝ)

name: EOC.cylinder_window_reindex
statement:
theorem cylinder_window_reindex (r Dcyl Y Z : ℕ) (hDcyl : 0 < Dcyl) (hYr : r ≤ Y) (hYZ : Y ≤ Z) :
    ∃ kmin N : ℕ,
      (∀ j < N, Y ≤ r + Dcyl * (kmin + j) ∧ r + Dcyl * (kmin + j) < Z) ∧
      (Z : ℝ) - (Y : ℝ) ≤ ((N : ℝ) + 2) * (Dcyl : ℝ)

name: EOC.harmonic_window_mass_lower_bound
statement:

    (hmem : ∀ j < N, A0 + D * j < Y + H) :
    (N : ℝ) / (Y + H) ≤ ∑ j ∈ range N, (1 : ℝ) / (A0 + D * j)

statement: theorem oddResidues_card (Q : ℕ) (hQ : 1 ≤ Q) : (oddResidues Q).card = 2 ^ (Q - 1)

name: EOC.residue_harmonic_mass_discrepancy
statement:
theorem residue_harmonic_mass_discrepancy
    (d : ℕ → ℕ) (t r : ℕ) (h : Realizes d t r) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (Q : ℕ) (hQ : 1 ≤ Q) (v : ℕ) (hvodd : Odd v)
    (kmin N : ℕ) :
    |∑ j ∈ range N,
        (if orbit (r + 2 ^ (S d t + 1) * (kmin + j)) t % 2 ^ Q = v % 2 ^ Q
          then (1 : ℝ) / ((r : ℝ) + (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) * ((kmin : ℝ) + j)) else 0)
      - (1 / (2 ^ (Q - 1) : ℝ)) *
          ∑ j ∈ range N, (1 : ℝ) / ((r : ℝ) + (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) * ((kmin : ℝ) + j))|
      ≤ 1 / ((r : ℝ) + (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) * (kmin : ℝ))

name: EOC.thick_window_conditional_residue_tv
statement:
theorem thick_window_conditional_residue_tv
    (d : ℕ → ℕ) (t r : ℕ) (h : Realizes d t r) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (Q : ℕ) (hQ : 1 ≤ Q) (Y H : ℕ) (hYr : r ≤ Y) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hH : η * (Y : ℝ) ≤ (H : ℝ))
    (hthick : 2 * (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) < η * (Y : ℝ)) :
    ∃ kmin N : ℕ, ∃ W : ℝ, 0 < W ∧
      W = ∑ j ∈ range N, (1 : ℝ) / ((r : ℝ) + (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) * ((kmin : ℝ) + j)) ∧
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ v ∈ oddResidues Q,
          |(∑ j ∈ range N,
              (if orbit (r + 2 ^ (S d t + 1) * (kmin + j)) t % 2 ^ Q = v % 2 ^ Q
                then (1 : ℝ) / ((r : ℝ) + (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) * ((kmin : ℝ) + j)) else 0)) / W
            - 1 / (2 ^ (Q - 1) : ℝ)|
        ≤ (2 ^ (Q - 1) : ℝ) / (2 * ((r : ℝ) + (2 ^ (S d t + 1) : ℝ) * (kmin : ℝ)) * W)

name: EOC.window_normalization_lower_bound

statement:
theorem prefixWord_mem (c : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) {μ : ℕ} (hμ : Odd μ)

name: EOC.SurvivorDensity.sum_half_pow_confined_eq
statement:
theorem sum_half_pow_confined_eq (c : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :

name: EOC.SurvivorDensity.survivor_count_le
statement:
theorem survivor_count_le (c : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (X : ℕ) :
    (((range X).filter fun μ => Odd μ ∧ Confined (c : ℝ) (fun i => a (orbit μ i)) N).card : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) / 2 * (Real.exp (lambdaStar * c) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(I0 * (N : ℝ)))) +
        (Nat.choose (collatzBarrier c N) N : ℝ)

name: EOC.ExceptionalPowerBound.I0_pos'
statement: theorem I0_pos' : 0 < I0

name: EOC.ExceptionalPowerBound.exceptional_count_le_of_firstMoment
statement:
theorem exceptional_count_le_of_firstMoment (U : ℕ) {X N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hX : 1 ≤ X)
    (A C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hNA : A * Real.logb 2 X ≤ N)
    (hyp : (((range X).filter fun μ =>
        Odd μ ∧ Confined (U : ℝ) (fun i => a (orbit μ i)) N).card : ℝ) ≤
      C * ((X : ℝ) / 2 * iidGeom2VectorProb N (geomPersistenceEvent collatzAlpha U N))) :
    (((range X).filter fun μ =>
        Odd μ ∧ ∀ M, Confined (U : ℝ) (fun i => a (orbit μ i)) M).card : ℝ) ≤
      C * Real.exp (lambdaStar * U) / 2 * (X : ℝ) ^ (1 - I0 * A)

name: EOC.ExceptionalPowerBound.exceptional_count_le_rpow
statement:
theorem exceptional_count_le_rpow (U : ℕ) {X : ℕ} (hX : 4 ≤ X) :
    (((range X).filter fun μ =>
        Odd μ ∧ ∀ N, Confined (U : ℝ) (fun i => a (orbit μ i)) N).card : ℝ) ≤
      Cconst U * (X : ℝ) ^ (1 - I0 / alpha)

name: EOC.ExceptionalPowerBound.f_alpha_div_log_two
statement: theorem f_alpha_div_log_two : f alpha / log 2 = alpha - I0

name: EOC.ExceptionalPowerBound.f_alpha_pos
statement: theorem f_alpha_pos : 0 < f alpha

name: EOC.ExceptionalPowerBound.f_le_tangent
statement:
theorem f_le_tangent {x y : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    f y ≤ f x + (y - x) * (log x - log (x - 1)) + (y - x) ^ 2 / x

name: EOC.ExceptionalPowerBound.log_alpha_ratio_pos
statement: theorem log_alpha_ratio_pos : 0 < log alpha - log (alpha - 1)

name: EOC.ExceptionalPowerBound.log_choose_barrier_le
statement:
theorem log_choose_barrier_le (c : ℕ) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    log (Nat.choose (collatzBarrier c N) N) ≤
      N * f alpha + c * (log alpha - log (alpha - 1)) + ((c : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2

name: EOC.ExceptionalPowerBound.one_le_Nstar
statement: theorem one_le_Nstar {X : ℕ} (hX : 4 ≤ X) : 1 ≤ Nstar X

name: EOC.ExceptionalPowerBound.one_sub_I0_div_alpha_eq
statement: theorem one_sub_I0_div_alpha_eq : 1 - I0 / alpha = Real.binEntropy alpha⁻¹ / log 2

name: EOC.ExceptionalPowerBound.survivor_count_le_rpow
statement:
theorem survivor_count_le_rpow (c : ℕ) {X : ℕ} (hX : 4 ≤ X) :
    (((range X).filter fun μ =>
        Odd μ ∧ Confined (c : ℝ) (fun i => a (orbit μ i)) (Nstar X)).card : ℝ) ≤
      Cconst c * (X : ℝ) ^ (1 - I0 / alpha)

name: EOC.SurvivorClusters.R_shiftWord
statement: theorem R_shiftWord (d : ℕ → ℕ) (t n : ℕ) : R (shiftWord d t) n = R d (t + n) - R d t

name: EOC.SurvivorClusters.confined_iff_of_modEq
statement:
theorem confined_iff_of_modEq {k x y : ℕ} (hx : Odd x) (hy : Odd y)
    (hxy : x ≡ y [MOD 2 ^ (S (orbitWord x) k + 1)]) (c : ℝ) :
    (∀ i < k, orbitWord x i = orbitWord y i) ∧
      (Confined c (orbitWord x) k ↔ Confined c (orbitWord y) k)

name: EOC.SurvivorClusters.confined_orbit_iff
statement:
theorem confined_orbit_iff (μ t N : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    Confined c (orbitWord (orbit μ t)) N ↔
      ∀ n ≤ N, R (orbitWord μ) (t + n) ≤ R (orbitWord μ) t + c

statement: theorem orbitWord_orbit (μ t : ℕ) : orbitWord (orbit μ t) = shiftWord (orbitWord μ) t

name: EOC.SurvivorClusters.predecessor
statement:
theorem predecessor {y : ℕ} (hy : Odd y) (h3 : y % 3 = 2) :
    let x := (2 * y - 1) / 3
    Odd x ∧ x < y ∧ 3 * x + 1 = 2 * y ∧ a x = 1 ∧ T x = y

name: EOC.SurvivorClusters.realizes_of_modEq
statement:
theorem realizes_of_modEq {d : ℕ → ℕ} {k x y : ℕ} (hx : Realizes d k x)
