    Realizes d k y

name: EOC.LiftDigits.S_mono
statement: theorem S_mono (d : ℕ → ℕ) {j N : ℕ} (h : j ≤ N) : S d j ≤ S d N

name: EOC.LiftDigits.S_succ'
statement: theorem S_succ' (d : ℕ → ℕ) (j : ℕ) : S d (j + 1) = S d j + d j

name: EOC.LiftDigits.card_realizers_dyadic
statement:
theorem card_realizers_dyadic (N K : ℕ) (hd : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (hK : K ≤ S d N)
    [DecidablePred fun μ => Realizes d N μ] :
    ((range (2 ^ K)).filter fun μ => Realizes d N μ).card =
      if leastRealizer d N < 2 ^ K then 1 else 0

name: EOC.LiftDigits.card_realizers_exact
statement:
theorem card_realizers_exact (N X : ℕ) (hd : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i)
    [DecidablePred fun μ => Realizes d N μ] :
    ((range X).filter fun μ => Realizes d N μ).card =
      X / 2 ^ (S d N + 1) + if leastRealizer d N < X % 2 ^ (S d N + 1) then 1 else 0

name: EOC.LiftDigits.eq_iff_realizes
statement:
theorem eq_iff_realizes {N j : ℕ} (hd : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (hj : j ≤ N) :
    leastRealizer d N = leastRealizer d j ↔ Realizes d N (leastRealizer d j)

name: EOC.LiftDigits.leastRealizer_eq_sum
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_eq_sum {N : ℕ} (hd : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) :
    leastRealizer d N = 1 + ∑ j ∈ range N, 2 ^ (S d j + 1) * liftDigit d j

name: EOC.LiftDigits.leastRealizer_mod
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_mod {N j : ℕ} (hd : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (hj : j ≤ N) :
    leastRealizer d N % 2 ^ (S d j + 1) = leastRealizer d j

name: EOC.LiftDigits.leastRealizer_succ
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_succ {j : ℕ} (hd : ∀ i < j + 1, 1 ≤ d i) :
    leastRealizer d (j + 1) = leastRealizer d j + 2 ^ (S d j + 1) * liftDigit d j

name: EOC.LiftDigits.leastRealizer_zero
statement: theorem leastRealizer_zero (d : ℕ → ℕ) : leastRealizer d 0 = 1

name: EOC.LiftDigits.liftDigit_lt
statement: theorem liftDigit_lt (j : ℕ) : liftDigit d j < 2 ^ d j

name: EOC.LiftDigits.realizes_iff_modEq
statement:
theorem realizes_iff_modEq {N μ : ℕ} (hd : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) :
    Realizes d N μ ↔ μ ≡ leastRealizer d N [MOD 2 ^ (S d N + 1)]

name: EOC.LiftDigits.realizes_of_prefix_suffix
statement:
theorem realizes_of_prefix_suffix {N j x : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ N) (hx : Realizes d j x)
    (hs : Realizes (shiftWord d j) (N - j) (orbit x j)) : Realizes d N x

name: EOC.LiftDigits.realizes_restrict
statement: theorem realizes_restrict {N t x : ℕ} (h : Realizes d N x) (ht : t ≤ N) : Realizes d t x

name: EOC.LiftDigits.suffix_memory
statement:
theorem suffix_memory {N j : ℕ} (hd : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (hj : j ≤ N) :
    leastRealizer d N < 2 ^ (S d j + 1) ↔ Realizes d N (leastRealizer d j)

name: EOC.LiftDigits.suffix_memory_modEq
statement:
theorem suffix_memory_modEq {N j : ℕ} (hd : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (hj : j ≤ N) :
    leastRealizer d N < 2 ^ (S d j + 1) ↔
      orbit (leastRealizer d j) j ≡ leastRealizer (shiftWord d j) (N - j)
        [MOD 2 ^ (S (shiftWord d j) (N - j) + 1)]

name: EOC.LiftDigits.suffix_memory_transport
statement:
theorem suffix_memory_transport {N j : ℕ} (hd : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (hj : j ≤ N) :
    leastRealizer d N < 2 ^ (S d j + 1) ↔
      Realizes (shiftWord d j) (N - j) (orbit (leastRealizer d j) j)

name: EOC.ResidueDiscrepancy.exceptional_count_le_of_leastRealizerBound
statement:
theorem exceptional_count_le_of_leastRealizerBound (U K : ℕ) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (A C : ℝ)
    (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hNA : A * K ≤ N)
    (hyp : ((((confinedWords N (collatzBarrier U)).filter fun w =>
        K ≤ w.total ∧ leastRealizer w.toInfinite N < 2 ^ K).card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      C * ∑ w ∈ (confinedWords N (collatzBarrier U)).filter (fun w => K ≤ w.total),
        (2 : ℝ) ^ K * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (w.total + 1)) :
    (((range (2 ^ K)).filter fun μ =>
        Odd μ ∧ ∀ M, Confined (U : ℝ) (fun i => a (orbit μ i)) M).card : ℝ) ≤
      C * Real.exp (TaoExternal.lambdaStar * U) / 2 *
        ((2 ^ K : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 - TaoExternal.I0 * A)

name: EOC.ResidueDiscrepancy.liftDigit_valuation
statement:
theorem liftDigit_valuation {d : ℕ → ℕ} {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hd : ∀ i < j + 1, 1 ≤ d i) :
    a (orbit (leastRealizer d j) j + 2 * 3 ^ j * liftDigit d j) = d j

name: EOC.ResidueDiscrepancy.orbit_leastRealizer_succ
statement:
theorem orbit_leastRealizer_succ {d : ℕ → ℕ} {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hd : ∀ i < j + 1, 1 ≤ d i) :
    orbit (leastRealizer d (j + 1)) j =
      orbit (leastRealizer d j) j + 2 * 3 ^ j * liftDigit d j

name: EOC.ResidueDiscrepancy.positive_toInfinite
statement:
theorem positive_toInfinite {c : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) {w : FiniteValuationWord N}
    (hw : w ∈ confinedWords N (collatzBarrier c)) : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ w.toInfinite i

name: EOC.ResidueDiscrepancy.seed_count_dyadic
statement:
theorem seed_count_dyadic (c : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (K : ℕ) :
    ((range (2 ^ K)).filter fun μ => Odd μ ∧ Confined (c : ℝ) (fun i => a (orbit μ i)) N).card =
      ∑ w ∈ confinedWords N (collatzBarrier c),
        (if w.total + 1 ≤ K then 2 ^ (K - (w.total + 1))
          else if leastRealizer w.toInfinite N < 2 ^ K then 1 else 0)

name: EOC.ResidueDiscrepancy.seed_count_eq_residue_sum
statement:
theorem seed_count_eq_residue_sum (c : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (X : ℕ) :
    ((range X).filter fun μ => Odd μ ∧ Confined (c : ℝ) (fun i => a (orbit μ i)) N).card =
      ∑ w ∈ confinedWords N (collatzBarrier c),
        (X / 2 ^ (w.total + 1) +
          if leastRealizer w.toInfinite N < X % 2 ^ (w.total + 1) then 1 else 0)

name: EOC.ResidueDiscrepancy.seed_count_eq_sum
statement:
theorem seed_count_eq_sum (c : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (X : ℕ) :
    ((range X).filter fun μ => Odd μ ∧ Confined (c : ℝ) (fun i => a (orbit μ i)) N).card =
      ∑ w ∈ confinedWords N (collatzBarrier c),
        ((range X).filter fun μ => Realizes w.toInfinite N μ).card

name: EOC.ResidueDiscrepancy.total_eq_S
statement: theorem total_eq_S (w : FiniteValuationWord N) : S w.toInfinite N = w.total

name: EOC.ResidueDiscrepancy.word_eq_of_realizes
statement:
theorem word_eq_of_realizes {w w' : FiniteValuationWord N} {μ : ℕ}
    (h : Realizes w.toInfinite N μ) (h' : Realizes w'.toInfinite N μ) : w = w'

name: EOC.ShellWeyl.card_filter_lt_eq_fourier
statement:
theorem card_filter_lt_eq_fourier {ι : Type*} (T : Finset ι) (r : ι → ℕ) (K n : ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ i ∈ T, r i < 2 ^ (K + n)) :
    (((T.filter fun i => r i < 2 ^ K).card : ℕ) : ℂ) =
      ((2 : ℂ) ^ n)⁻¹ * ∑ g : ZMod (2 ^ n), blockWeyl T r K n g

name: EOC.ShellWeyl.card_filter_lt_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_lt_le {ι : Type*} (T : Finset ι) (r : ι → ℕ) (K n : ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ i ∈ T, r i < 2 ^ (K + n)) :
    (((T.filter fun i => r i < 2 ^ K).card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      (T.card : ℝ) / 2 ^ n +
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ * ∑ g ∈ univ.erase (0 : ZMod (2 ^ n)), ‖blockWeyl T r K n g‖

name: EOC.ShellWeyl.card_filter_lt_le_of_weyl
statement:
theorem card_filter_lt_le_of_weyl {ι : Type*} (T : Finset ι) (r : ι → ℕ) (K n : ℕ) (C : ℝ)
    (hr : ∀ i ∈ T, r i < 2 ^ (K + n))
    (hW : ∑ g ∈ univ.erase (0 : ZMod (2 ^ n)), ‖blockWeyl T r K n g‖ ≤ (C - 1) * T.card) :
    (((T.filter fun i => r i < 2 ^ K).card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ C * (T.card : ℝ) / 2 ^ n

name: EOC.ShellWeyl.dyadicPhase_eq_prefix
statement:
theorem dyadicPhase_eq_prefix {J N : ℕ} (hd : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (hJ : J ≤ N) (h : ℕ) :
    (2 ^ (S d N - S d J) * h * leastRealizer d N) % 2 ^ (S d N + 1) =
      2 ^ (S d N - S d J) * ((h * leastRealizer d J) % 2 ^ (S d J + 1))

name: EOC.ShellWeyl.exceptional_count_le_of_weyl
statement:
theorem exceptional_count_le_of_weyl (U K : ℕ) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (A C : ℝ) (hC : 1 ≤ C)
    (hNA : A * K ≤ N) (hW : WeylBound U N K C) :
    (((range (2 ^ K)).filter fun μ =>
        Odd μ ∧ ∀ M, Confined (U : ℝ) (fun i => a (orbit μ i)) M).card : ℝ) ≤
      C * Real.exp (TaoExternal.lambdaStar * U) / 2 *
        ((2 ^ K : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 - TaoExternal.I0 * A)

name: EOC.ShellWeyl.leastRealizerBound_of_weyl
statement:
theorem leastRealizerBound_of_weyl (U N K : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (hW : WeylBound U N K C) :
    ((((confinedWords N (collatzBarrier U)).filter fun w =>
        K ≤ w.total ∧ leastRealizer w.toInfinite N < 2 ^ K).card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      C * ∑ w ∈ (confinedWords N (collatzBarrier U)).filter (fun w => K ≤ w.total),
        (2 : ℝ) ^ K * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (w.total + 1)

name: EOC.ShellWeyl.leastRealizer_eq_prefix_add
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_eq_prefix_add {j N : ℕ} (hd : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (hj : j ≤ N) :
    leastRealizer d N = leastRealizer d j +
      2 ^ (S d j + 1) * ∑ i ∈ Ico j N, 2 ^ (S d i - S d j) * liftDigit d i

name: EOC.ShellWeyl.leastRealizer_lt_shell
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_lt_shell {U N s : ℕ} {w : FiniteValuationWord N} (hw : w ∈ shell U N s)
    (K : ℕ) (hK : K ≤ s) : leastRealizer w.toInfinite N < 2 ^ (K + (s + 1 - K))

name: EOC.ShellWeyl.shell_count_le
statement:
theorem shell_count_le {U N K s : ℕ} (C : ℝ) (hK : K ≤ s)
    (hW : ∑ g ∈ univ.erase (0 : ZMod (2 ^ (s + 1 - K))), ‖shellWeyl U N K s g‖ ≤
      (C - 1) * (shell U N s).card) :
    ((((shell U N s).filter fun w => leastRealizer w.toInfinite N < 2 ^ K).card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      C * ∑ w ∈ shell U N s, (2 : ℝ) ^ K * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (w.total + 1)

name: EOC.ShellWeyl.sum_norm_le_of_pointwise
statement:
theorem sum_norm_le_of_pointwise {ι : Type*} (T : Finset ι) (r : ι → ℕ) (K n : ℕ) (C : ℝ)
    (hC : 1 ≤ C)
    (hW : ∀ g : ZMod (2 ^ n), g ≠ 0 → ‖blockWeyl T r K n g‖ ≤ (C - 1) * T.card / 2 ^ n) :
    ∑ g ∈ univ.erase (0 : ZMod (2 ^ n)), ‖blockWeyl T r K n g‖ ≤ (C - 1) * T.card

name: EOC.ShellWeyl.topBlock_eq_suffix
statement:
theorem topBlock_eq_suffix {j N : ℕ} (hd : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (hj : j ≤ N) :
    leastRealizer d N / 2 ^ (S d j + 1) =
      ∑ i ∈ Ico j N, 2 ^ (S d i - S d j) * liftDigit d i

name: EOC.ShellWeyl.topBlock_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem topBlock_eq_zero_iff {K n r : ℕ} (hr : r < 2 ^ (K + n)) :
    topBlock K n r = 0 ↔ r < 2 ^ K

name: EOC.ShellWeyl.weylBound_of_pointwise
statement:
theorem weylBound_of_pointwise (U N K : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 1 ≤ C)
    (hP : ∀ s, K ≤ s → ∀ g : ZMod (2 ^ (s + 1 - K)), g ≠ 0 →
      ‖shellWeyl U N K s g‖ ≤ (C - 1) * (shell U N s).card / 2 ^ (s + 1 - K)) :
    WeylBound U N K C

name: EOC.PrefixSuffixBilinear.bilinear_incidence_le
statement:
theorem bilinear_incidence_le (Y I : Finset G) (N : G → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hμ : 0 ≤ (∑ z, N z) / Fintype.card G)
    (hcoll : ∑ z, (N z - (∑ z, N z) / Fintype.card G) ^ 2 ≤
      ε ^ 2 * Y.card * ((∑ z, N z) / Fintype.card G) ^ 2) :
    ∑ y ∈ Y, ∑ i ∈ I, N (y - i) ≤
      (1 + ε) * ((Y.card : ℝ) * I.card * ((∑ z, N z) / Fintype.card G))

name: EOC.PrefixSuffixBilinear.bilinear_incidence_sq_le
statement:
theorem bilinear_incidence_sq_le (Y I : Finset G) (N : G → ℝ) :
    (∑ y ∈ Y, ∑ i ∈ I, N (y - i) -
        (Y.card : ℝ) * I.card * ((∑ z, N z) / Fintype.card G)) ^ 2 ≤
      (I.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * Y.card * ∑ z, (N z - (∑ z, N z) / Fintype.card G) ^ 2

name: EOC.PrefixSuffixBilinear.concat_lt
statement:
theorem concat_lt {j N : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ N) :
    concatBlock d j N < 2 ^ (S (shiftWord d j) (N - j))

name: EOC.PrefixSuffixBilinear.concat_modEq
statement:
theorem concat_modEq {j N : ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hd : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (hj : j ≤ N) :
    orbit (leastRealizer d j) j + 2 * 3 ^ j * concatBlock d j N ≡
      leastRealizer (shiftWord d j) (N - j) [MOD 2 ^ (S (shiftWord d j) (N - j) + 1)]

name: EOC.PrefixSuffixBilinear.concat_unique
statement:
theorem concat_unique {j N k : ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hd : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (hj : j ≤ N)
    (hk : k < 2 ^ (S (shiftWord d j) (N - j)))
    (hmod : orbit (leastRealizer d j) j + 2 * 3 ^ j * k ≡
      leastRealizer (shiftWord d j) (N - j) [MOD 2 ^ (S (shiftWord d j) (N - j) + 1)]) :
    k = concatBlock d j N

name: EOC.PrefixSuffixBilinear.leastRealizer_eq_concat
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_eq_concat {j N : ℕ} (hd : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (hj : j ≤ N) :
    leastRealizer d N = leastRealizer d j + 2 ^ (S d j + 1) * concatBlock d j N

name: EOC.PrefixSuffixBilinear.lt_pow_iff_concat
statement:
theorem lt_pow_iff_concat {j N K : ℕ} (hd : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (hj : j ≤ N) (hK : S d j < K) :
    leastRealizer d N < 2 ^ K ↔ concatBlock d j N < 2 ^ (K - S d j - 1)

name: EOC.existsUnique_zero_lift_digit
statement:
theorem existsUnique_zero_lift_digit (d : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hd_pos : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) :
    ∃! e : ℕ, 1 ≤ e ∧ liftDigit (extendDigit d N e) N = 0

name: EOC.leastRealizer_eq_of_agree
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_eq_of_agree (d d' : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ) (hagree : ∀ i < N, d i = d' i) :
    leastRealizer d N = leastRealizer d' N

name: EOC.leastRealizer_succ_eq
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_succ_eq (d : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ) (hd_pos : ∀ i < N + 1, 1 ≤ d i) :
    leastRealizer d (N + 1) = leastRealizer d N + liftDigit d N * 2 ^ (S d N + 1)

name: EOC.leastRealizer_succ_modEq
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_succ_modEq (d : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ) (hd_pos : ∀ i < N + 1, 1 ≤ d i) :
    leastRealizer d (N + 1) ≡ leastRealizer d N [MOD 2 ^ (S d N + 1)]

name: EOC.leastRealizer_succ_modEq_of_agree
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_succ_modEq_of_agree (d d' : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ)
    (hagree : ∀ i < N, d i = d' i)
    (hd_pos : ∀ i < N + 1, 1 ≤ d i) (hd'_pos : ∀ i < N + 1, 1 ≤ d' i) :
    leastRealizer d (N + 1) ≡ leastRealizer d' (N + 1) [MOD 2 ^ (S d N + 1)]

name: EOC.leastRealizer_succ_mod_eq
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_succ_mod_eq (d : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ) (hd_pos : ∀ i < N + 1, 1 ≤ d i) :
    leastRealizer d (N + 1) % 2 ^ (S d N + 1) = leastRealizer d N

name: EOC.leastRealizer_succ_ne_of_digit_ne
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_succ_ne_of_digit_ne (d d' : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ)
    (hd_pos : ∀ i < N + 1, 1 ≤ d i) (hd'_pos : ∀ i < N + 1, 1 ≤ d' i)
    (hne : d N ≠ d' N) :
    leastRealizer d (N + 1) ≠ leastRealizer d' (N + 1)

name: EOC.liftDigit_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem liftDigit_eq_zero_iff (d : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hd_pos : ∀ i < N + 1, 1 ≤ d i) :
    liftDigit d N = 0 ↔ a (orbit (leastRealizer d N) N) = d N

name: EOC.liftDigit_extendDigit_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem liftDigit_extendDigit_eq_zero_iff (d : ℕ → ℕ) (N e : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hd_pos : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i) (he : 1 ≤ e) :
    liftDigit (extendDigit d N e) N = 0 ↔ a (orbit (leastRealizer d N) N) = e

name: EOC.liftDigit_extendDigit_injective
statement:
theorem liftDigit_extendDigit_injective (d : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ) (hd_pos : ∀ i < N, 1 ≤ d i)
    (e1 e2 : ℕ) (he1 : 1 ≤ e1) (he2 : 1 ≤ e2) (hne : e1 ≠ e2) :
    liftDigit (extendDigit d N e1) N ≠ liftDigit (extendDigit d N e2) N

name: EOC.liftDigit_lt
statement:
theorem liftDigit_lt (d : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ) :
    liftDigit d N < 2 ^ d N

name: EOC.liftDigit_unique
statement:
theorem liftDigit_unique (d : ℕ → ℕ) (N k : ℕ) (hd_pos : ∀ i < N + 1, 1 ≤ d i)
    (heq : leastRealizer d (N + 1) = leastRealizer d N + k * 2 ^ (S d N + 1)) :
    k = liftDigit d N

name: EOC.q_modEq_of_leastRealizer_eq
statement:
theorem q_modEq_of_leastRealizer_eq (d d' : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ) (hS : S d N = S d' N)
    (hLeq : leastRealizer d N = leastRealizer d' N) :
    q d N ≡ q d' N [MOD 2 ^ (S d N + 1)]

name: EOC.q_succ_extendDigit_eq
statement:
theorem q_succ_extendDigit_eq (d : ℕ → ℕ) (N e1 e2 : ℕ) :
    q (extendDigit d N e1) (N + 1) = q (extendDigit d N e2) (N + 1)

name: EOC.swap_two_digits_leastRealizer_ne
statement:
theorem swap_two_digits_leastRealizer_ne (u v : ℕ) (huv : u ≠ v) :
    S (fun i => if i = 0 then u else v) 2 = S (fun i => if i = 0 then v else u) 2 ∧
    leastRealizer (fun i => if i = 0 then u else v) 2
      ≠ leastRealizer (fun i => if i = 0 then v else u) 2

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.S_concat_pre
statement:
theorem S_concat_pre (P : FiniteValuationWord j0) (v : FiniteValuationWord (N - j0))
    (hj : j0 ≤ N) : S (concat N P v).toInfinite j0 = P.total

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.S_concat_suf
statement:
theorem S_concat_suf (P : FiniteValuationWord j0) (v : FiniteValuationWord (N - j0))
    (hj : j0 ≤ N) : S (shiftWord (concat N P v).toInfinite j0) (N - j0) = v.total

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.alphaV_injOn
statement:
theorem alphaV_injOn {L j0 t : ℕ} (V : Finset (FiniteValuationWord L))
    (hV : ∀ v ∈ V, v.Positive ∧ v.total = t) :
    Set.InjOn (alphaV j0 t) (↑V : Set (FiniteValuationWord L))

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.card_image_range
statement:
theorem card_image_range {t M : ℕ} (hM : M ≤ 2 ^ t) :
    ((range M).image (fun i : ℕ => (i : ZMod (2 ^ t)))).card = M

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.concatBlock_cast
statement:
theorem concatBlock_cast (P : FiniteValuationWord j0) (v : FiniteValuationWord (N - j0))
    (hj1 : 1 ≤ j0) (hjN : j0 < N) (hP : P.Positive) (hv : v.Positive) :
    ((concatBlock (concat N P v).toInfinite j0 N : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ v.total)) =
      alphaV j0 v.total v - betaP v.total P

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.concat_pre_suf
statement:
theorem concat_pre_suf (w : FiniteValuationWord N) (hj : j0 ≤ N) :
    concat N (pre j0 w) (suf j0 w) = w

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.concat_toInfinite_ge
statement:
theorem concat_toInfinite_ge (P : FiniteValuationWord j0) (v : FiniteValuationWord (N - j0))
    {i : ℕ} (hi : j0 ≤ i) (hiN : i < N) :
    (concat N P v).toInfinite i = v.toInfinite (i - j0)

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.concat_toInfinite_lt
statement:
theorem concat_toInfinite_lt (P : FiniteValuationWord j0) (v : FiniteValuationWord (N - j0))
    (hj : j0 ≤ N) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < j0) : (concat N P v).toInfinite i = P.toInfinite i

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.exceptional_count_le_of_prefixCollision
statement:
theorem exceptional_count_le_of_prefixCollision (U K j0 : ℕ) {N : ℕ} (A ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hj1 : 1 ≤ j0) (hjN : j0 < N) (hbK : collatzBarrier U j0 < K) (hNA : A * K ≤ N)
    (hcoll : PrefixCollisionBound (collatzBarrier U) N j0 K ε) :
    (((range (2 ^ K)).filter fun μ =>
        Odd μ ∧ ∀ M, Confined (U : ℝ) (fun i => a (orbit μ i)) M).card : ℝ) ≤
      (1 + ε) * Real.exp (TaoExternal.lambdaStar * U) / 2 *
        ((2 ^ K : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 - TaoExternal.I0 * A)

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.leastRealizerBound_of_prefixCollision
statement:
theorem leastRealizerBound_of_prefixCollision (U N K j0 : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hj1 : 1 ≤ j0) (hjN : j0 < N) (hbK : collatzBarrier U j0 < K)
    (hcoll : PrefixCollisionBound (collatzBarrier U) N j0 K ε) :
    ((((confinedWords N (collatzBarrier U)).filter fun w =>
        K ≤ w.total ∧ leastRealizer w.toInfinite N < 2 ^ K).card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      (1 + ε) * ∑ w ∈ (confinedWords N (collatzBarrier U)).filter (fun w => K ≤ w.total),
        (2 : ℝ) ^ K * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (w.total + 1)

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.leastRealizer_concat_pre
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_concat_pre (P : FiniteValuationWord j0) (v : FiniteValuationWord (N - j0))
    (hj : j0 ≤ N) :
    leastRealizer (concat N P v).toInfinite j0 = leastRealizer P.toInfinite j0

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.leastRealizer_concat_suf
statement:
theorem leastRealizer_concat_suf (P : FiniteValuationWord j0) (v : FiniteValuationWord (N - j0))
    (hj : j0 ≤ N) :
    leastRealizer (shiftWord (concat N P v).toInfinite j0) (N - j0) =
      leastRealizer v.toInfinite (N - j0)

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.lt_pow_iff_incidence
statement:
theorem lt_pow_iff_incidence (P : FiniteValuationWord j0) (v : FiniteValuationWord (N - j0))
    (hj1 : 1 ≤ j0) (hjN : j0 < N) (hP : P.Positive) (hv : v.Positive) {K : ℕ}
    (hK : P.total < K) :
    leastRealizer (concat N P v).toInfinite N < 2 ^ K ↔
      (alphaV j0 v.total v - betaP v.total P).val < 2 ^ (K - P.total - 1)

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.mem_image_range_iff
statement:
theorem mem_image_range_iff {t M : ℕ} (hM : M ≤ 2 ^ t) (x : ZMod (2 ^ t)) :
    x ∈ (range M).image (fun i : ℕ => (i : ZMod (2 ^ t))) ↔ x.val < M

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.mem_shellP
statement:
theorem mem_shellP {b : ℕ → ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j0) {σ : ℕ} {P : FiniteValuationWord j0}
    (hP : P ∈ shellP b j0 σ) : P.Positive ∧ BarrierConfined b P ∧ P.total = σ

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.mem_shellV
statement:
theorem mem_shellV {b : ℕ → ℕ} (hjN : j0 < N) {σ t : ℕ} {v : FiniteValuationWord (N - j0)}
    (hv : v ∈ shellV b N j0 σ t) : v.Positive ∧ v.total = t

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.mem_split
statement:
theorem mem_split (b : ℕ → ℕ) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j0) (hjN : j0 < N) {s σ : ℕ}
    {w : FiniteValuationWord N} :
    (w ∈ (confinedWords N b).filter (fun w => w.total = s) ∧ (pre j0 w).total = σ) ↔
      (pre j0 w ∈ shellP b j0 σ ∧ suf j0 w ∈ shellV b N j0 σ (s - σ) ∧ σ ≤ s)

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.odd_leastRealizer_of_positive
statement:
theorem odd_leastRealizer_of_positive {n : ℕ} {w : FiniteValuationWord n} (hw : w.Positive) :
    Odd (leastRealizer w.toInfinite n)

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.positive_concat
statement:
theorem positive_concat {P : FiniteValuationWord j0} {v : FiniteValuationWord (N - j0)}
    (hP : P.Positive) (hv : v.Positive) : (concat N P v).Positive

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.positive_pre
statement:
theorem positive_pre {w : FiniteValuationWord N} (hw : w.Positive) (hj : j0 ≤ N) :
    (pre j0 w).Positive

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.positive_suf
statement:
theorem positive_suf {w : FiniteValuationWord N} (hw : w.Positive) :
    (suf j0 w).Positive

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.positive_toInfinite_of_positive
statement:
theorem positive_toInfinite_of_positive {n : ℕ} {w : FiniteValuationWord n} (hw : w.Positive) :
    ∀ i < n, 1 ≤ w.toInfinite i

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.pre_concat
statement:
theorem pre_concat (P : FiniteValuationWord j0) (v : FiniteValuationWord (N - j0))
    (hj : j0 ≤ N) : pre j0 (concat N P v) = P

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.pre_toInfinite
statement:
theorem pre_toInfinite (w : FiniteValuationWord N) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < j0) :
    (pre j0 w).toInfinite i = w.toInfinite i

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.prefixSum_ge_of_positive
statement:
theorem prefixSum_ge_of_positive {n : ℕ} {w : FiniteValuationWord n} (hw : w.Positive)
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ n) : i ≤ w.prefixSum i

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.prefixSum_pre
statement:
theorem prefixSum_pre (w : FiniteValuationWord N) (hj : j0 ≤ N) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ j0) :
    (pre j0 w).prefixSum i = w.prefixSum i

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.prefixSum_suf
statement:
theorem prefixSum_suf (w : FiniteValuationWord N) (hj : j0 ≤ N) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ N - j0) :
    (suf j0 w).prefixSum i + w.prefixSum j0 = w.prefixSum (j0 + i)

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.s_congr
statement: theorem s_congr {d d' : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} (h : ∀ i < n, d i = d' i) : s d n = s d' n

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.shellP_eq_empty
statement:
theorem shellP_eq_empty {b : ℕ → ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j0) {σ : ℕ} (hσ : b j0 < σ) :
    shellP b j0 σ = ∅

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.shell_count_le_of_collision
statement:
theorem shell_count_le_of_collision (b : ℕ → ℕ) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j0) (hjN : j0 < N) {K s : ℕ}
    (hbK : b j0 < K) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hKs : K ≤ s)
    (hcoll : PrefixCollisionBound b N j0 K ε) :
    (∑ w ∈ (confinedWords N b).filter (fun w => w.total = s),
        (if leastRealizer w.toInfinite N < 2 ^ K then 1 else 0 : ℝ)) ≤
      (1 + ε) * ∑ _w ∈ (confinedWords N b).filter (fun w => w.total = s),
        (2 : ℝ) ^ K * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (s + 1)

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.shift_concat_agree
statement:
theorem shift_concat_agree (P : FiniteValuationWord j0) (v : FiniteValuationWord (N - j0))
    (hj : j0 ≤ N) : ∀ i < N - j0, shiftWord (concat N P v).toInfinite j0 i = v.toInfinite i

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.split_count_le
statement:
theorem split_count_le (b : ℕ → ℕ) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j0) (hjN : j0 < N) {K s σ : ℕ} (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hKs : K ≤ s) (hσK : σ < K)
    (hcoll : (2 : ℝ) ^ (s - σ) * ∑ z : ZMod (2 ^ (s - σ)), prefixCount b j0 σ (s - σ) z ^ 2 ≤
      ((shellP b j0 σ).card : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        (1 + ε ^ 2 * (shellV b N j0 σ (s - σ)).card / 2 ^ (s - σ))) :
    (∑ P ∈ shellP b j0 σ, ∑ v ∈ shellV b N j0 σ (s - σ),
        (if leastRealizer (concat N P v).toInfinite N < 2 ^ K then 1 else 0 : ℝ)) ≤
      (1 + ε) * ∑ _P ∈ shellP b j0 σ, ∑ _v ∈ shellV b N j0 σ (s - σ),
        (2 : ℝ) ^ K * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (s + 1)

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.suf_concat
statement:
theorem suf_concat (P : FiniteValuationWord j0) (v : FiniteValuationWord (N - j0))
    (hj : j0 ≤ N) : suf j0 (concat N P v) = v

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.suf_toInfinite
statement:
theorem suf_toInfinite (w : FiniteValuationWord N) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < N - j0) :
    (suf j0 w).toInfinite i = shiftWord w.toInfinite j0 i

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.sum_prefixCount
statement:
theorem sum_prefixCount (b : ℕ → ℕ) (j0 σ t : ℕ) :
    ∑ z, prefixCount b j0 σ t z = ((shellP b j0 σ).card : ℝ)

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.sum_shell_eq_sum_split
statement:
theorem sum_shell_eq_sum_split {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R] (b : ℕ → ℕ) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j0)
    (hjN : j0 < N) (s : ℕ) (F : FiniteValuationWord N → R) :
    ∑ w ∈ (confinedWords N b).filter (fun w => w.total = s), F w =
      ∑ σ ∈ range (s + 1), ∑ P ∈ shellP b j0 σ, ∑ v ∈ shellV b N j0 σ (s - σ),
        F (concat N P v)

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.three_pow_mul_invThree
statement:
theorem three_pow_mul_invThree (j0 t : ℕ) :
    ((3 ^ j0 : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ t)) * invThree j0 t = 1

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.total_pre
statement:
theorem total_pre (w : FiniteValuationWord N) (hj : j0 ≤ N) :
    (pre j0 w).total = w.prefixSum j0

name: EOC.PrefixCollision.total_suf
statement:
theorem total_suf (w : FiniteValuationWord N) (hj : j0 ≤ N) :
    (suf j0 w).total + w.prefixSum j0 = w.total

name: EOC.PrefixStateFormula.endState_carry
statement:
theorem endState_carry (j : ℕ) (hd : ∀ i < j, 1 ≤ d i) :
    2 ^ S d j * orbit (leastRealizer d j) j = 3 ^ j * leastRealizer d j + q d j

name: EOC.PrefixStateFormula.endState_int_formula
statement:
theorem endState_int_formula {σ t j : ℕ} {m r q : ℕ} {B : ℤ}
    (hcarry : 2 ^ σ * m = 3 ^ j * r + q)
    (hB : (3 : ℤ) ^ j * (r + 2 ^ (σ + 1) * B) ≡ 2 ^ σ - q [ZMOD 2 ^ (σ + t + 1)]) :
    (m : ℤ) ≡ 1 - 2 * 3 ^ j * B [ZMOD 2 ^ (t + 1)]

name: EOC.PrefixStateFormula.endState_modEq_iff
statement:
theorem endState_modEq_iff (j t : ℕ) (hd : ∀ i < j, 1 ≤ d i) (he : ∀ i < j, 1 ≤ e i)
    (hS : S d j = S e j) :
    orbit (leastRealizer d j) j ≡ orbit (leastRealizer e j) j [MOD 2 ^ (t + 1)] ↔
      3 ^ j * leastRealizer d j + q d j ≡ 3 ^ j * leastRealizer e j + q e j
        [MOD 2 ^ (S d j + t + 1)]

name: EOC.PrefixStateFormula.exists_block
statement:
theorem exists_block {σ t j : ℕ} {m r q : ℕ} (hcarry : 2 ^ σ * m = 3 ^ j * r + q)
    (hm : Odd m) :
    ∃ B : ℤ, (3 : ℤ) ^ j * (r + 2 ^ (σ + 1) * B) ≡ 2 ^ σ - q [ZMOD 2 ^ (σ + t + 1)]

name: EOC.PrefixStateFormula.norm_stdAddChar
statement: theorem norm_stdAddChar (x : ZMod n) : ‖(ZMod.stdAddChar x : ℂ)‖ = 1

name: EOC.PrefixStateFormula.sum_sq_norm_eq_card_pairs
statement:
theorem sum_sq_norm_eq_card_pairs (T : Finset ι) (β : ι → ZMod n) :
    ∑ g : ZMod n, ‖∑ i ∈ T, (ZMod.stdAddChar (g * β i) : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 =
      n * (((T ×ˢ T).filter fun p => β p.1 = β p.2).card : ℝ)

name: EOC.ShellwiseChain.exceptional_count_le_of_shellwise
statement:
theorem exceptional_count_le_of_shellwise (U K j0 : ℕ) {N : ℕ} (A C : ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j0) (hjN : j0 < N) (hbK : collatzBarrier U j0 < K)
    (hNA : A * K ≤ N) (hsw : ShellwiseBound (collatzBarrier U) N j0 K c)
    (hweight : ∑ s ∈ Icc K (collatzBarrier U N), ∑ σ ∈ range K,
        c s σ * haarShare (collatzBarrier U) N j0 K s σ ≤
      C * ∑ w ∈ (confinedWords N (collatzBarrier U)).filter (fun w => K ≤ w.total),
        (2 : ℝ) ^ K * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (w.total + 1)) :
    (((range (2 ^ K)).filter fun μ =>
        Odd μ ∧ ∀ M, Confined (U : ℝ) (fun i => a (orbit μ i)) M).card : ℝ) ≤
      C * Real.exp (TaoExternal.lambdaStar * U) / 2 *
        ((2 ^ K : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 - TaoExternal.I0 * A)

name: EOC.ShellwiseChain.fiber_eq
statement:
theorem fiber_eq (W : Finset (FiniteValuationWord N)) {K s : ℕ} (hKs : K ≤ s) :
    (W.filter fun w => K ≤ w.total).filter (fun w => w.total = s) =
      W.filter fun w => w.total = s

name: EOC.ShellwiseChain.haarShare_eq
statement:
theorem haarShare_eq (b : ℕ → ℕ) (N j0 K s σ : ℕ) :
    haarShare b N j0 K s σ = ((shellP b j0 σ).card : ℝ) * (shellV b N j0 σ (s - σ)).card *
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ K * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (s + 1))

name: EOC.ShellwiseChain.haarShare_nonneg
statement: theorem haarShare_nonneg (b : ℕ → ℕ) (N j0 K s σ : ℕ) : 0 ≤ haarShare b N j0 K s σ

name: EOC.ShellwiseChain.haar_mass_eq
statement:
theorem haar_mass_eq (b : ℕ → ℕ) {N j0 : ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j0) (hjN : j0 < N) {K : ℕ}
    (hbK : b j0 < K) :
    ∑ w ∈ (confinedWords N b).filter (fun w => K ≤ w.total),
        (2 : ℝ) ^ K * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (w.total + 1) =
      ∑ s ∈ Icc K (b N), ∑ σ ∈ range K, haarShare b N j0 K s σ

name: EOC.ShellwiseChain.incCount_le_of_collision_or_trivial
statement:
theorem incCount_le_of_collision_or_trivial (b : ℕ → ℕ) {N j0 : ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j0) (hjN : j0 < N)
    {K s σ : ℕ} (hKs : K ≤ s) (hσK : σ < K) {c : ℝ}
    (h : (∃ ε : ℝ, 0 ≤ ε ∧ 1 + ε ≤ c ∧ CollisionAt b N j0 s σ ε) ∨ (2 : ℝ) ^ (s + 1 - K) ≤ c) :
    incCount b N j0 K s σ ≤ c * haarShare b N j0 K s σ

name: EOC.ShellwiseChain.leastRealizerBound_of_shellwise
statement:
theorem leastRealizerBound_of_shellwise (U N K j0 : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (hj1 : 1 ≤ j0) (hjN : j0 < N) (hbK : collatzBarrier U j0 < K)
    (hsw : ShellwiseBound (collatzBarrier U) N j0 K c)
    (hweight : ∑ s ∈ Icc K (collatzBarrier U N), ∑ σ ∈ range K,
        c s σ * haarShare (collatzBarrier U) N j0 K s σ ≤
      C * ∑ w ∈ (confinedWords N (collatzBarrier U)).filter (fun w => K ≤ w.total),
        (2 : ℝ) ^ K * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (w.total + 1)) :
    ((((confinedWords N (collatzBarrier U)).filter fun w =>
        K ≤ w.total ∧ leastRealizer w.toInfinite N < 2 ^ K).card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      C * ∑ w ∈ (confinedWords N (collatzBarrier U)).filter (fun w => K ≤ w.total),
        (2 : ℝ) ^ K * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (w.total + 1)

name: EOC.ShellwiseChain.split_count_le_trivial
statement:
theorem split_count_le_trivial (b : ℕ → ℕ) (N j0 : ℕ) {K s : ℕ} (σ : ℕ) (hKs : K ≤ s) :
    incCount b N j0 K s σ ≤ 2 ^ (s + 1 - K) * haarShare b N j0 K s σ

name: EOC.ShellwiseChain.sum_fresh_split
statement:
theorem sum_fresh_split {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R] (b : ℕ → ℕ) {N j0 : ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j0)
    (hjN : j0 < N) {K s : ℕ} (hbK : b j0 < K) (hKs : K ≤ s) (F : FiniteValuationWord N → R) :
    ∑ w ∈ (confinedWords N b).filter (fun w => w.total = s), F w =
      ∑ σ ∈ range K, ∑ P ∈ shellP b j0 σ, ∑ v ∈ shellV b N j0 σ (s - σ),
        F (concat N P v)

name: EOC.ShellwiseChain.sum_haarShare
statement:
theorem sum_haarShare (b : ℕ → ℕ) {N j0 : ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j0) (hjN : j0 < N) {K s : ℕ}
    (hbK : b j0 < K) (hKs : K ≤ s) :
    ∑ σ ∈ range K, haarShare b N j0 K s σ =
      (((confinedWords N b).filter (fun w => w.total = s)).card : ℝ) *
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ K * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (s + 1))

name: EOC.ShellwiseChain.total_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem total_mem_Icc {b : ℕ → ℕ} {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) {K : ℕ} {w : FiniteValuationWord N}
    (hw : w ∈ (confinedWords N b).filter fun w => K ≤ w.total) : w.total ∈ Icc K (b N)

name: EOC.ShellwiseChain.weighted_of_le
statement:
theorem weighted_of_le (U N K j0 : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j0) (hjN : j0 < N)
    (hbK : collatzBarrier U j0 < K)
    (hc : ∀ s ∈ Icc K (collatzBarrier U N), ∀ σ ∈ range K, c s σ ≤ C) :
    ∑ s ∈ Icc K (collatzBarrier U N), ∑ σ ∈ range K,
        c s σ * haarShare (collatzBarrier U) N j0 K s σ ≤
      C * ∑ w ∈ (confinedWords N (collatzBarrier U)).filter (fun w => K ≤ w.total),
        (2 : ℝ) ^ K * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (w.total + 1)

name: EOC.SwapBound.G_le_pow_mul_N
statement:
theorem G_le_pow_mul_N (κ : ℝ) (hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ) (hκ1 : κ ≤ 1) (good : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Prop)
    [∀ i S u, Decidable (good i S u)]
    (hgood : ∀ i S u, good i S u → blockWeight b φ i S u ≤ κ * (blockSet b i S u).card)
    (r : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (hr0 : ∀ i S, r i 0 S = 0) (hr1 : ∀ i S, r i 1 S = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ i n S u, u ∈ range (b (i + 2) + 1) → (blockSet b i S u).Nonempty →
      N b σ (i + 2) n (S + u) ≠ 0 →
      r i (n + 2) S ≤ r (i + 2) n (S + u) + if good i S u then 1 else 0) :
    ∀ n i S, G b φ σ i n S ≤ κ ^ r i n S * N b σ i n S
  | 0, i, S => by simp only [G, N, hr0, pow_zero, one_mul]; exact le_rfl
  | 1, i, S => by
      simp only [G, N, hr1, pow_zero, one_mul]
      exact le_rfl
  | n + 2, i, S => by
      simp only [G]
      rw [N_two, mul_sum]
      refine sum_le_sum fun u hu => ?_
      have ih := G_le_pow_mul_N κ hκ0 hκ1 good hgood r hr0 hr1 hstep n (i + 2) (S + u)
      have hw0 := blockWeight_nonneg b φ i S u
      have hN0 := N_nonneg b σ n (i + 2) (S + u)
      calc blockWeight b φ i S u * G b φ σ (i + 2) n (S + u)
          ≤ blockWeight b φ i S u * (κ ^ r (i + 2) n (S + u) * N b σ (i + 2) n (S + u))

name: EOC.SwapBound.N_nonneg
statement:
theorem N_nonneg : ∀ n i S, 0 ≤ N b σ i n S
  | 0, i, S => by simp only [N]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  | n + 1, i, S => by
      simp only [N]
      exact sum_nonneg fun d _ => N_nonneg n (i + 1) (S + d)

name: EOC.SwapBound.N_two
statement:
theorem N_two (i n S : ℕ) :
    N b σ i (n + 2) S =
      ∑ u ∈ range (b (i + 2) + 1), N b σ (i + 2) n (S + u) * (blockSet b i S u).card

name: EOC.SwapBound.T_two
statement:
theorem T_two (i n S : ℕ) :
    T b φ σ i (n + 2) S = ee (φ i S) *
      ∑ u ∈ range (b (i + 2) + 1), T b φ σ (i + 2) n (S + u) *
        ∑ d ∈ blockSet b i S u, ee (φ (i + 1) (S + d))

name: EOC.SwapBound.blockWeight_le_card
statement:
theorem blockWeight_le_card (i S u : ℕ) :
    blockWeight b φ i S u ≤ (blockSet b i S u).card

name: EOC.SwapBound.blockWeight_le_of_pairs
statement:
theorem blockWeight_le_of_pairs (i S u : ℕ) {c f : ℝ} (hc1 : c ≤ 1)
    (hc : ∀ d ∈ lo (blockSet b i S u) u,
      |Real.cos (π * (φ (i + 1) (S + d) - φ (i + 1) (S + (u - d))))| ≤ c)
    (hf : ((single (blockSet b i S u) u).card : ℝ) ≤ f * (blockSet b i S u).card) :
    blockWeight b φ i S u ≤ (f + (1 - f) * c) * (blockSet b i S u).card

name: EOC.SwapBound.blockWeight_nonneg
statement: theorem blockWeight_nonneg (i S u : ℕ) : 0 ≤ blockWeight b φ i S u

name: EOC.SwapBound.card_eq
statement:
theorem card_eq (hA : ∀ d ∈ A, d < u) :
    (A.card : ℝ) = 2 * (lo A u).card + (single A u).card

name: EOC.SwapBound.ee_add_ee
statement:
theorem ee_add_ee (a b : ℝ) :
    ee a + ee b = ee ((a + b) / 2) * (2 * Complex.cos ((π * (a - b) : ℝ) : ℂ))

name: EOC.SwapBound.lt_of_mem_blockSet
statement: theorem lt_of_mem_blockSet {i S u d : ℕ} (hd : d ∈ blockSet b i S u) : d < u

name: EOC.SwapBound.norm_T_le_G
statement:
theorem norm_T_le_G : ∀ n i S, ‖T b φ σ i n S‖ ≤ G b φ σ i n S
  | 0, i, S => by
      simp only [T, G]; split_ifs <;> simp
  | 1, i, S => by
      simp only [T, G]
      rw [norm_mul, norm_ee, one_mul]
      refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      refine sum_congr rfl fun d _ => ?_
      split_ifs <;> simp
  | n + 2, i, S => by
      refine (norm_T_two_le b φ σ i n S).trans ?_
      simp only [G]
      refine sum_le_sum fun u _ => ?_
      rw [mul_comm (blockWeight b φ i S u)]
      exact mul_le_mul (norm_T_le_G n (i + 2) (S + u)) (norm_block_le b φ i S u)
        (norm_nonneg _) ((norm_nonneg _).trans (norm_T_le_G n (i + 2) (S + u)))

name: EOC.SwapBound.norm_T_le_pow_mul_N
statement:
theorem norm_T_le_pow_mul_N (κ : ℝ) (hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ) (hκ1 : κ ≤ 1) (good : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Prop)
    [∀ i S u, Decidable (good i S u)]
    (hgood : ∀ i S u, good i S u → blockWeight b φ i S u ≤ κ * (blockSet b i S u).card)
    (r : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (hr0 : ∀ i S, r i 0 S = 0) (hr1 : ∀ i S, r i 1 S = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ i n S u, u ∈ range (b (i + 2) + 1) → (blockSet b i S u).Nonempty →
      N b σ (i + 2) n (S + u) ≠ 0 →
      r i (n + 2) S ≤ r (i + 2) n (S + u) + if good i S u then 1 else 0)
    (n i S : ℕ) : ‖T b φ σ i n S‖ ≤ κ ^ r i n S * N b σ i n S

name: EOC.SwapBound.norm_T_two_le
statement:
theorem norm_T_two_le (i n S : ℕ) :
    ‖T b φ σ i (n + 2) S‖ ≤ ∑ u ∈ range (b (i + 2) + 1),
      ‖T b φ σ (i + 2) n (S + u)‖ * ‖∑ d ∈ blockSet b i S u, ee (φ (i + 1) (S + d))‖

name: EOC.SwapBound.norm_block_le
statement:
theorem norm_block_le (i S u : ℕ) :
    ‖∑ d ∈ blockSet b i S u, ee (φ (i + 1) (S + d))‖ ≤ blockWeight b φ i S u

name: EOC.SwapBound.norm_ee
statement: theorem norm_ee (x : ℝ) : ‖ee x‖ = 1

name: EOC.SwapBound.norm_ee_add_ee
statement: theorem norm_ee_add_ee (a b : ℝ) : ‖ee a + ee b‖ = 2 * |Real.cos (π * (a - b))|

name: EOC.SwapBound.norm_sum_ee_le_swapWeight
statement:
theorem norm_sum_ee_le_swapWeight (hA : ∀ d ∈ A, d < u) (ψ : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ‖∑ d ∈ A, ee (ψ d)‖ ≤ swapWeight A u ψ

name: EOC.SwapBound.regroup
statement:
theorem regroup {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (B1 B2 S : ℕ) (g F : ℕ → R) :
    ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 (B1 - S), g d * ∑ e ∈ Icc 1 (B2 - (S + d)), F (S + d + e) =
      ∑ u ∈ range (B2 + 1), F (S + u) *
        ∑ d ∈ (Icc 1 (B1 - S)).filter (fun d => d < u ∧ u - d ≤ B2 - (S + d)), g d

name: EOC.SwapBound.sum_hi_eq
statement:
theorem sum_hi_eq {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (hA : ∀ d ∈ A, d < u) (f : ℕ → M) :
    ∑ d ∈ hi A u, f d = ∑ d ∈ lo A u, f (u - d)

name: EOC.SwapBound.sum_split
statement:
theorem sum_split {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → M) :
    ∑ d ∈ A, f d = ∑ d ∈ lo A u, f d + ∑ d ∈ hi A u, f d + ∑ d ∈ single A u, f d

name: EOC.SwapBound.swapWeight_le_card
statement:
theorem swapWeight_le_card (hA : ∀ d ∈ A, d < u) (ψ : ℕ → ℝ) :
    swapWeight A u ψ ≤ A.card

name: EOC.SwapBound.swapWeight_le_of_cos_le
EOC.SwapBound.swapWeight_nonneg
statement: theorem swapWeight_nonneg (ψ : ℕ → ℝ) : 0 ≤ swapWeight A u ψ

name: EOC.SwapCollatz.N_eq_card_cont
statement: theorem N_eq_card_cont (n i S : ℕ) : SwapBound.N b σ i n S = (cont b σ i n S).card

name: EOC.SwapCollatz.N_eq_card_shellP
statement: theorem N_eq_card_shellP (j0 : ℕ) : SwapBound.N b σ 0 j0 0 = (shellP b j0 σ).card

name: EOC.SwapCollatz.T_eq_sum_cont
statement:
theorem T_eq_sum_cont (φ : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∀ n i S, SwapBound.T b φ σ i n S = ∑ v ∈ cont b σ i n S,
      ∏ k ∈ range n, ee (φ (i + k) (S + s (FiniteValuationWord.toInfinite v) k))
  | 0, i, S => by
      simp only [SwapBound.T, range_zero, prod_empty, sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      by_cases h : S = σ
      · have hc : cont b σ i 0 S = {Fin.elim0}

name: EOC.SwapCollatz.T_eq_sum_shellP
statement:
theorem T_eq_sum_shellP (φ : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (j0 : ℕ) :
    SwapBound.T b φ σ 0 j0 0 =
      ∑ P ∈ shellP b j0 σ, ∏ i ∈ range j0, ee (φ i (FiniteValuationWord.prefixSum P i))

name: EOC.SwapCollatz.T_zero_eq_N
statement:
theorem T_zero_eq_N :
    ∀ n i S, SwapBound.T b (fun _ _ => 0) σ i n S = (SwapBound.N b σ i n S : ℂ)
  | 0, i, S => by simp only [SwapBound.T, SwapBound.N]; split_ifs <;> simp
  | n + 1, i, S => by
      simp only [SwapBound.T, SwapBound.N]
      have : ee 0 = 1

name: EOC.SwapCollatz.cont_zero_eq_shellP
statement: theorem cont_zero_eq_shellP (j0 : ℕ) : cont b σ 0 j0 0 = shellP b j0 σ

name: EOC.SwapCollatz.mem_cont
statement:
theorem mem_cont {i n S : ℕ} {v : Fin n → ℕ} :
    v ∈ cont b σ i n S ↔ (∀ a, 1 ≤ v a ∧ v a ≤ σ) ∧
      (∀ k < n, S + s (FiniteValuationWord.toInfinite v) (k + 1) ≤ b (i + k + 1)) ∧
      S + s (FiniteValuationWord.toInfinite v) n = σ

name: EOC.SwapCollatz.mem_cont_cons
statement:
theorem mem_cont_cons {i n S d : ℕ} {v : Fin n → ℕ} :
    (Fin.cons d v : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ) ∈ cont b σ i (n + 1) S ↔
      d ∈ Icc 1 (b (i + 1) - S) ∧ v ∈ cont b σ (i + 1) n (S + d)

name: EOC.SwapCollatz.norm_sum_shellP_le_G
statement:
theorem norm_sum_shellP_le_G (h m : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℕ) (j0 : ℕ) :
    ‖∑ P ∈ shellP b j0 σ, ∏ i ∈ range j0,
        ee (collatzPhase h m u i (FiniteValuationWord.prefixSum P i))‖ ≤
      SwapBound.G b (collatzPhase h m u) σ 0 j0 0

name: EOC.SwapCollatz.norm_sum_shellP_le_pow_mul_card
statement:
theorem norm_sum_shellP_le_pow_mul_card (h m : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℕ) (j0 : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ)
    (hκ1 : κ ≤ 1) (good : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Prop) [∀ i S u, Decidable (good i S u)]
    (hgood : ∀ i S u', good i S u' →
      blockWeight b (collatzPhase h m u) i S u' ≤ κ * (blockSet b i S u').card)
    (r : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (hr0 : ∀ i S, r i 0 S = 0) (hr1 : ∀ i S, r i 1 S = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ i n S u', u' ∈ range (b (i + 2) + 1) → (blockSet b i S u').Nonempty →
      SwapBound.N b σ (i + 2) n (S + u') ≠ 0 →
      r i (n + 2) S ≤ r (i + 2) n (S + u') + if good i S u' then 1 else 0) :
    ‖∑ P ∈ shellP b j0 σ, ∏ i ∈ range j0,
        ee (collatzPhase h m u i (FiniteValuationWord.prefixSum P i))‖ ≤
      κ ^ r 0 j0 0 * (shellP b j0 σ).card

name: EOC.SwapCollatz.s_cons_succ
statement:
theorem s_cons_succ {n : ℕ} (d : ℕ) (v : Fin n → ℕ) (k : ℕ) :
    s (FiniteValuationWord.toInfinite (Fin.cons d v : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ)) (k + 1) =
      d + s (FiniteValuationWord.toInfinite v) k

name: EOC.SwapCollatz.sum_cont_succ
statement:
theorem sum_cont_succ {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (i n S : ℕ) (F : (Fin (n + 1) → ℕ) → M) :
    ∑ w ∈ cont b σ i (n + 1) S, F w =
      ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 (b (i + 1) - S), ∑ v ∈ cont b σ (i + 1) n (S + d),
        F (Fin.cons d v : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ)

name: EOC.SwapCollatz.toInfinite_cons_succ
statement:
theorem toInfinite_cons_succ {n : ℕ} (d : ℕ) (v : Fin n → ℕ) (k : ℕ) :
    FiniteValuationWord.toInfinite (Fin.cons d v : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ) (k + 1) =
      FiniteValuationWord.toInfinite v k

name: EOC.SwapCollatz.toInfinite_cons_zero
statement:
theorem toInfinite_cons_zero {n : ℕ} (d : ℕ) (v : Fin n → ℕ) :
    FiniteValuationWord.toInfinite (Fin.cons d v : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ) 0 = d

name: EOC.TwistExpansion.Sfun_le
statement: theorem Sfun_le (r : ℕ) : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → Sfun r θ ≤ 1 + r / 2 * sin (π * θ)

name: EOC.TwistExpansion.Sfun_succ
statement:
theorem Sfun_succ (r : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    Sfun (r + 1) θ = |cos (π * (θ / 2))| * Sfun r (θ / 2) +
      |cos (π * ((θ + 1) / 2))| * Sfun r ((θ + 1) / 2)

name: EOC.TwistExpansion.Sfun_term
statement:
theorem Sfun_term (r : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (b k : ℕ) :
    ∏ j ∈ range (r + 1), |cos (π * ((θ + ((2 * k + b : ℕ) : ℝ)) * 2 ^ j / 2 ^ (r + 1)))| =
      (∏ j ∈ range r, |cos (π * (((θ + b) / 2 + k) * 2 ^ j / 2 ^ r))|) *
        |cos (π * ((θ + b) / 2))|

name: EOC.TwistExpansion.collision_le_of_psi
statement:
theorem collision_le_of_psi {ι : Type*} (T : Finset ι) (r t : ℕ) (y : ι → ℕ)
    (hy : ∀ i ∈ T, y i < 2 ^ (r + t)) (η : ℝ)
    (hΨ : ∀ lam, lam < 2 ^ (r + t) → ¬ 2 ^ t ∣ lam → ‖Psi T r t y lam‖ ≤ η * T.card) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ t * ((((T ×ˢ T).filter fun p => y p.1 / 2 ^ r = y p.2 / 2 ^ r).card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      (T.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * (1 + (1 + r / 2) ^ 2 * 2 ^ t * η ^ 2)

name: EOC.TwistExpansion.collision_le_weighted
statement:
theorem collision_le_weighted {ι : Type*} (T : Finset ι) (r t : ℕ) (y : ι → ℕ)
    (hy : ∀ i ∈ T, y i < 2 ^ (r + t)) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ t * ((((T ×ˢ T).filter fun p => y p.1 / 2 ^ r = y p.2 / 2 ^ r).card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      (T.card : ℝ) ^ 2 + (1 + r / 2) * ∑ g ∈ Ico 1 (2 ^ t), ∑ k ∈ range (2 ^ r),
        ‖coef r t (g + 2 ^ t * k)‖ * ‖Psi T r t y (g + 2 ^ t * k)‖ ^ 2

name: EOC.TwistExpansion.sum_sq_norm_ee_eq_card_pairs

name: EOC.WeightedChain.weighted_phi_decay_implies_exceptional_bound
statement:
theorem weighted_phi_decay_implies_exceptional_bound (U K j0 : ℕ) {N : ℕ} (A C : ℝ)
    (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j0) (hjN : j0 < N) (hbK : collatzBarrier U j0 < K)
    (hNA : A * K ≤ N)
    (hpair : ∀ s σ, K ≤ s → σ < K →
      (∃ ε : ℝ, 0 ≤ ε ∧ 1 + ε ≤ c s σ ∧ WeightedFourier (collatzBarrier U) N j0 s σ ε) ∨
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (s + 1 - K) ≤ c s σ)
    (hweight : ∑ s ∈ Icc K (collatzBarrier U N), ∑ σ ∈ range K,
        c s σ * haarShare (collatzBarrier U) N j0 K s σ ≤
      C * ∑ w ∈ (confinedWords N (collatzBarrier U)).filter (fun w => K ≤ w.total),
        (2 : ℝ) ^ K * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (w.total + 1)) :
    (((range (2 ^ K)).filter fun μ =>
        Odd μ ∧ ∀ M, Confined (U : ℝ) (fun i => a (orbit μ i)) M).card : ℝ) ≤
      C * Real.exp (TaoExternal.lambdaStar * U) / 2 *
        ((2 ^ K : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 - TaoExternal.I0 * A)

theorem grid_sieve {ι : Type*} (T : Finset ι) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (A : ι → ℤ) (δ : ι → ℝ)

    ∑ k ∈ range H, ‖∑ i ∈ T, ee ((a + k) * ((A i : ℝ) / q + δ i))‖ ^ 2 ≤

name: EOC.IntervalSieve.sqrt_sum_sq_sum_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_sum_sq_sum_le {α β : Type*} (I : Finset α) (U : Finset β) (b : β → α → ℝ) :
    √(∑ l ∈ I, (∑ S ∈ U, b S l) ^ 2) ≤ ∑ S ∈ U, √(∑ l ∈ I, b S l ^ 2)

name: EOC.IntervalSieve.sum_Ico_one_div_le
statement: theorem sum_Ico_one_div_le (q : ℕ) : ∑ c ∈ Ico 1 q, (1 : ℝ) / c ≤ 1 + Real.log q

name: EOC.IntervalSieve.sum_Ico_one_div_reflect
statement:
theorem sum_Ico_one_div_reflect (q : ℕ) :
    ∑ c ∈ Ico 1 q, (1 : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) - c) = ∑ c ∈ Ico 1 q, (1 : ℝ) / c

name: EOC.IntervalSieve.sum_kb_le
statement:
theorem sum_kb_le (H q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    ∑ c ∈ range q, kb H q c ≤ H + 2 * q * (1 + Real.log q)

name: EOC.IntervalSieve.sum_sq_norm_le_pairs
statement:
theorem sum_sq_norm_le_pairs {ι : Type*} (T : Finset ι) (ζ : ι → ℝ) (H : ℕ) (a : ℝ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range H, ‖∑ i ∈ T, ee ((a + k) * ζ i)‖ ^ 2 ≤

name: EOC.IntervalSieve.two_abs_le_abs_sin

name: EOC.WhiteRun.abs_cres_le

name: EOC.WhiteRun.card_Ico_filter_mod_le

theorem card_Ico_filter_mod_le (a H q c : ℕ) :

name: EOC.WhiteRun.card_fibre_mod_le
statement:
theorem card_fibre_mod_le {ι : Type*} (T : Finset ι) (X : ι → ℕ) (Xmax q c : ℕ)

name: EOC.WhiteRun.cres_dvd
statement: theorem cres_dvd (x : ℤ) (M : ℕ) : (2 : ℤ) ^ M ∣ cres x M - x

name: EOC.WhiteRun.cres_rec

theorem cres_rec {lam w v : ℤ} {n M M' : ℕ} (hw : (2 : ℤ) ^ M ∣ w * 3 ^ (n + 3) - 1)
    (hv : (2 : ℤ) ^ M ∣ v * 3 ^ n - 1) (hM : M' ≤ M) :

statement:

name: EOC.WhiteRun.white_step
EOC.PsiSieve.W_modEq

statement: theorem ee_prod {ι : Type*} (T : Finset ι) (x : ι → ℝ) : ∏ i ∈ T, ee (x i) = ee (∑ i ∈ T, x i)

name: EOC.PsiSieve.norm_Fpre_eq_grid
statement:
theorem norm_Fpre_eq_grid (m N S lam : ℕ) :
    ‖Fpre b m N S lam‖ = ‖∑ P ∈ shellP b N S, ee ((lam : ℝ) *
      (((-(W m N : ℤ) * C P.toInfinite N : ℤ) : ℝ) / ((3 ^ N : ℕ) : ℝ) +
        (C P.toInfinite N : ℝ) / (3 ^ N * 2 ^ m)))‖

name: EOC.PsiSieve.norm_Fpre_le
statement: theorem norm_Fpre_le (m N S lam : ℕ) : ‖Fpre b m N S lam‖ ≤ (shellP b N S).card

name: EOC.PsiSieve.norm_Gsuf_le
statement:
theorem norm_Gsuf_le (m j0 N σ S lam : ℕ) :
    ‖Gsuf b m j0 N σ S lam‖ ≤ (shellV b j0 N S (σ - S)).card

name: EOC.PsiSieve.prefixSum_concat_ge
statement:
theorem prefixSum_concat_ge {N j0 : ℕ} (P : FiniteValuationWord N) (v : FiniteValuationWord (j0 - N))
    (hj : N ≤ j0) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ j0 - N) :
    (concat j0 P v).prefixSum (N + k) = P.total + v.prefixSum k

name: EOC.PsiSieve.prefixSum_concat_lt
statement:
theorem prefixSum_concat_lt {N j0 : ℕ} (P : FiniteValuationWord N) (v : FiniteValuationWord (j0 - N))
    (hj : N ≤ j0) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ N) : (concat j0 P v).prefixSum i = P.prefixSum i

name: EOC.PsiSieve.prefix_phase_grid
statement:
theorem prefix_phase_grid (m N : ℕ) (P : FiniteValuationWord N) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, (Zpre m N P : ℝ) / 2 ^ m =
      z + ((-(W m N : ℤ) * C P.toInfinite N : ℤ) : ℝ) / 3 ^ N +
        (C P.toInfinite N : ℝ) / (3 ^ N * 2 ^ m)

name: EOC.PsiSieve.prod_cp_eq
statement:
theorem prod_cp_eq (lam m N : ℕ) (P : FiniteValuationWord N) :
    ∏ i ∈ range N, ee (cp lam m i (P.prefixSum i)) = ee (-((lam : ℝ) * ((Zpre m N P : ℝ) / 2 ^ m)))

name: EOC.PsiSieve.psi_shell_sieve
statement:
theorem psi_shell_sieve (j0 σ t N : ℕ) (hN1 : 1 ≤ N) (hNj : N < j0)
    (hX : 2 * Xmax b N ≤ 2 ^ (σ + 1 + t)) (a H : ℕ) :
    √(∑ k ∈ range H, ‖TwistExpansion.Psi (shellP b j0 σ) (σ + 1) t (WeightedChain.yPrime j0 σ t) (a + k)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      ∑ S ∈ range (σ + 1), ((shellV b j0 N S (σ - S)).card : ℝ) *
        min (√(H : ℝ) * (shellP b N S).card)
          √((shellP b N S).card * (Xmax b N / 3 ^ N + 1 : ℕ) *
            (H + 2 * (3 ^ N : ℕ) * (1 + Real.log (3 ^ N : ℕ))))

name: EOC.PsiSieve.psi_split
statement:
theorem psi_split (m j0 N σ lam : ℕ) (hN1 : 1 ≤ N) (hNj : N < j0) :
    ∑ P ∈ shellP b j0 σ, ∏ i ∈ range j0, ee (cp lam m i (P.prefixSum i)) =
      ∑ S ∈ range (σ + 1), Fpre b m N S lam * Gsuf b m j0 N σ S lam

name: EOC.PsiSieve.reciprocity
statement:
theorem reciprocity {k m : ℕ} {u v : ℤ} (hu : u * 3 ^ k ≡ 1 [ZMOD 2 ^ m])
    (hv : v * 2 ^ m ≡ 1 [ZMOD 3 ^ k]) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, (u : ℝ) / 2 ^ m + v / 3 ^ k - 1 / (3 ^ k * 2 ^ m) = z

name: EOC.PsiSieve.sum_int_add
statement:
theorem sum_int_add {ι : Type*} (T : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ T, ∃ z : ℤ, f i = z + g i) : ∃ z : ℤ, ∑ i ∈ T, f i = z + ∑ i ∈ T, g i

name: EOC.PsiSieve.sum_sq_norm_Fpre_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_norm_Fpre_le (m N S : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hX : 2 * Xmax b N ≤ 2 ^ m) (a H : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range H, ‖Fpre b m N S (a + k)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (shellP b N S).card * (Xmax b N / 3 ^ N + 1 : ℕ) *
        (H + 2 * (3 ^ N : ℕ) * (1 + Real.log (3 ^ N : ℕ)))

name: EOC.PsiSieve.uInv_modEq
statement:
theorem uInv_modEq (m i : ℕ) :
    ((WeightedChain.uInv m i : ℕ) : ℤ) * 3 ^ (i + 1) ≡ 1 [ZMOD 2 ^ m]

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.card_cshell_le
statement: theorem card_cshell_le (r t u : ℕ) : (cshell r t u).card ≤ 2 ^ (u + 1)

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.cdist_lt
statement: theorem cdist_lt {r t lam : ℕ} (h : lam ∈ nondvd r t) : cdist (2 ^ (r + t)) lam < 2 ^ (r + t)

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.cdist_pos
statement: theorem cdist_pos {r t lam : ℕ} (h : lam ∈ nondvd r t) : 0 < cdist (2 ^ (r + t)) lam

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.mem_cshell_bounds
statement:
theorem mem_cshell_bounds {r t u lam : ℕ} (h : lam ∈ cshell r t u) :
    2 ^ u ≤ cdist (2 ^ (r + t)) lam ∧ cdist (2 ^ (r + t)) lam < 2 ^ (u + 1)

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.norm_coef_le_cshell
statement:
theorem norm_coef_le_cshell {r t u lam : ℕ} (h : lam ∈ cshell r t u) :
    ‖coef r t lam‖ ≤ 2 ^ t / (2 * 2 ^ u)

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.sum_Ico_one_two_pow
statement:
theorem sum_Ico_one_two_pow {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → M) :
    ∑ lam ∈ Ico 1 (2 ^ n), f lam = ∑ u ∈ range n, ∑ lam ∈ Ico (2 ^ u) (2 ^ (u + 1)), f lam

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.sum_fibre_eq_sum_nondvd
statement:
theorem sum_fibre_eq_sum_nondvd {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (r t : ℕ) (F : ℕ → M) :
    ∑ g ∈ Ico 1 (2 ^ t), ∑ k ∈ range (2 ^ r), F (g + 2 ^ t * k) =
      ∑ lam ∈ (Ico 1 (2 ^ (r + t))).filter (fun lam => ¬ 2 ^ t ∣ lam), F lam

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.sum_fibre_eq_sum_shells
statement:
theorem sum_fibre_eq_sum_shells {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (r t : ℕ) (F : ℕ → M) :
    ∑ g ∈ Ico 1 (2 ^ t), ∑ k ∈ range (2 ^ r), F (g + 2 ^ t * k) =
      ∑ u ∈ range (r + t),
        ∑ lam ∈ (Ico (2 ^ u) (2 ^ (u + 1))).filter (fun lam => ¬ 2 ^ t ∣ lam), F lam

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.sum_nondvd_eq_sum_cshell
statement:
theorem sum_nondvd_eq_sum_cshell {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (r t : ℕ) (F : ℕ → M) :
    ∑ lam ∈ nondvd r t, F lam = ∑ u ∈ range (r + t), ∑ lam ∈ cshell r t u, F lam

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.weightedFourier_lhs_shells
statement:
theorem weightedFourier_lhs_shells (b : ℕ → ℕ) (j0 s σ : ℕ) :
    ∑ g ∈ Ico 1 (2 ^ (s - σ)), ∑ k ∈ range (2 ^ (σ + 1)),
      ‖coef (σ + 1) (s - σ) (g + 2 ^ (s - σ) * k)‖ *
        ‖Psi (shellP b j0 σ) (σ + 1) (s - σ) (yPrime j0 σ (s - σ)) (g + 2 ^ (s - σ) * k)‖ ^ 2 =
    ∑ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)),
      ∑ lam ∈ (Ico (2 ^ u) (2 ^ (u + 1))).filter (fun lam => ¬ 2 ^ (s - σ) ∣ lam),
        ‖coef (σ + 1) (s - σ) lam‖ *
          ‖Psi (shellP b j0 σ) (σ + 1) (s - σ) (yPrime j0 σ (s - σ)) lam‖ ^ 2

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.weightedFourier_of_shell_averages
statement:
theorem weightedFourier_of_shell_averages (b : ℕ → ℕ) (N j0 s σ : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ u, 0 ≤ a u)
    (hshell : ∀ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)),
      ∑ lam ∈ cshell (σ + 1) (s - σ) u,
        ‖Psi (shellP b j0 σ) (σ + 1) (s - σ) (yPrime j0 σ (s - σ)) lam‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (cshell (σ + 1) (s - σ) u).card * (a u * ((shellP b j0 σ).card : ℝ) ^ 2))
    (hfin : (1 + ((σ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) * 2 ^ (s - σ) * ∑ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)), a u ≤
      ε ^ 2 * (shellV b N j0 σ (s - σ)).card / 2 ^ (s - σ)) :
    WeightedFourier b N j0 s σ ε

name: EOC.ShellDecomposition.weighted_sum_le_of_shell_averages
statement:
theorem weighted_sum_le_of_shell_averages (r t : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ lam, 0 ≤ F lam) (ha : ∀ u, 0 ≤ a u)
    (hshell : ∀ u ∈ range (r + t), ∑ lam ∈ cshell r t u, F lam ≤ (cshell r t u).card * a u) :
    ∑ g ∈ Ico 1 (2 ^ t), ∑ k ∈ range (2 ^ r), ‖coef r t (g + 2 ^ t * k)‖ * F (g + 2 ^ t * k) ≤
      2 ^ t * ∑ u ∈ range (r + t), a u

name: EOC.ShellRefined.card_mul_weight_le
statement:
theorem card_mul_weight_le (r t u : ℕ) :
    ((cshell r t u).card : ℝ) * min 1 (2 ^ t / (2 * 2 ^ u)) ≤ min (2 ^ (u + 1)) (2 ^ t)

name: EOC.ShellRefined.norm_coef_le_cshell_refined
statement:
theorem norm_coef_le_cshell_refined {r t u lam : ℕ} (h : lam ∈ cshell r t u) :
    ‖coef r t lam‖ ≤ min 1 (2 ^ t / (2 * 2 ^ u))

name: EOC.ShellRefined.norm_coef_le_one
statement: theorem norm_coef_le_one (r t lam : ℕ) : ‖coef r t lam‖ ≤ 1

name: EOC.ShellRefined.weightedFourier_of_shell_averages_refined
statement:
theorem weightedFourier_of_shell_averages_refined (b : ℕ → ℕ) (N j0 s σ : ℕ) (ε : ℝ)
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ u, 0 ≤ a u)
    (hshell : ∀ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)),
      ∑ lam ∈ cshell (σ + 1) (s - σ) u,
        ‖Psi (shellP b j0 σ) (σ + 1) (s - σ) (yPrime j0 σ (s - σ)) lam‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (cshell (σ + 1) (s - σ) u).card * (a u * ((shellP b j0 σ).card : ℝ) ^ 2))
    (hfin : (1 + ((σ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) *
        ∑ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)), min (2 ^ (u + 1)) (2 ^ (s - σ)) * a u ≤
      ε ^ 2 * (shellV b N j0 σ (s - σ)).card / 2 ^ (s - σ)) :
    WeightedFourier b N j0 s σ ε

name: EOC.ShellRefined.weighted_sum_le_of_shell_averages_refined
statement:
theorem weighted_sum_le_of_shell_averages_refined (r t : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ lam, 0 ≤ F lam) (ha : ∀ u, 0 ≤ a u)
    (hshell : ∀ u ∈ range (r + t), ∑ lam ∈ cshell r t u, F lam ≤ (cshell r t u).card * a u) :
    ∑ g ∈ Ico 1 (2 ^ t), ∑ k ∈ range (2 ^ r), ‖coef r t (g + 2 ^ t * k)‖ * F (g + 2 ^ t * k) ≤
      ∑ u ∈ range (r + t), min (2 ^ (u + 1)) (2 ^ t) * a u

name: EOC.SpacingChain.centDistZ_div_le_dZ
statement:
theorem centDistZ_div_le_dZ {M : ℤ} (hM : 0 < M) (n : ℤ) :
    (centDistZ M n : ℝ) / M ≤ dZ ((n : ℝ) / M)

name: EOC.SpacingChain.centDistZ_nonneg
statement: theorem centDistZ_nonneg {M : ℤ} (hM : 0 < M) (n : ℤ) : 0 ≤ centDistZ M n

name: EOC.SpacingChain.kerZ_le_H
statement: theorem kerZ_le_H (H : ℕ) (M n : ℤ) : kerZ H M n ≤ H

name: EOC.SpacingChain.odd_quotient
statement:
theorem odd_quotient {d e : ℕ → ℕ} {i j : ℕ} (hagree : ∀ l < i, d l = e l) (hne : d i ≠ e i)
    (hij : i + 1 < j) (hd : ∀ l < j, 1 ≤ d l) (he : ∀ l < j, 1 ≤ e l) :
    ∃ Δ : ℤ, Odd Δ ∧ (q d j : ℤ) - q e j = 2 ^ (s d i + min (d i) (e i)) * Δ

name: EOC.SpacingChain.pair_kernel_le
statement:
theorem pair_kernel_le (H : ℕ) (a : ℝ) {M : ℤ} (hM : 0 < M) (n : ℤ) :
    ‖∑ k ∈ range H, ee ((a + k) * ((n : ℝ) / M))‖ ≤ kerZ H M n

name: EOC.SpacingChain.spacingExponent_implies_weightedFourier
statement:
theorem spacingExponent_implies_weightedFourier (b : ℕ → ℕ) (N j0 s σ : ℕ) (C θ : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hV : 0 < (shellV b N j0 σ (s - σ)).card)
    (hshell : ∀ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)),
      ∑ lam ∈ cshell (σ + 1) (s - σ) u,
        ‖Psi (shellP b j0 σ) (σ + 1) (s - σ) (yPrime j0 σ (s - σ)) lam‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (cshell (σ + 1) (s - σ) u).card *
        ((C * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-θ * u)) * ((shellP b j0 σ).card : ℝ) ^ 2)) :
    WeightedFourier b N j0 s σ
      (Real.sqrt ((1 + ((σ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) *
        (∑ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)),
          min (2 ^ (u + 1)) (2 ^ (s - σ)) * (C * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-θ * u))) *
          2 ^ (s - σ) / (shellV b N j0 σ (s - σ)).card))

name: EOC.SpacingChain.sum_sq_le_kernel
statement:
theorem sum_sq_le_kernel {ι : Type*} (T : Finset ι) (y : ι → ℤ) (H : ℕ) (a : ℝ) {M : ℤ}
    (hM : 0 < M) :
    ∑ k ∈ range H, ‖∑ i ∈ T, ee ((a + k) * ((y i : ℝ) / M))‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ i ∈ T, ∑ j ∈ T, kerZ H M (y i - y j)

name: EOC.SpacingChain.sum_sq_le_pairSpacing
statement:
theorem sum_sq_le_pairSpacing {ι : Type*} (T : Finset ι) (y : ι → ℤ) (H : ℕ) (a : ℝ) {M D : ℤ}
    (hM : 0 < M) (hD : 0 < D) :
    ∑ k ∈ range H, ‖∑ i ∈ T, ee ((a + k) * ((y i : ℝ) / M))‖ ^ 2 ≤
      H * pairSpacing T y M D + (T.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((M : ℝ) / (2 * D))

name: EOC.SpacingChain.weightedFourier_of_shell_bound
statement:
theorem weightedFourier_of_shell_bound (b : ℕ → ℕ) (N j0 s σ : ℕ) (ε C θ : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hV : 0 < (shellV b N j0 σ (s - σ)).card)
    (hshell : ∀ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)),
      ∑ lam ∈ cshell (σ + 1) (s - σ) u,
        ‖Psi (shellP b j0 σ) (σ + 1) (s - σ) (yPrime j0 σ (s - σ)) lam‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (cshell (σ + 1) (s - σ) u).card *
        ((C * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-θ * u)) * ((shellP b j0 σ).card : ℝ) ^ 2))
    (hε : (1 + ((σ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) *
        (∑ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)),
          min (2 ^ (u + 1)) (2 ^ (s - σ)) * (C * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-θ * u))) *
          2 ^ (s - σ) / (shellV b N j0 σ (s - σ)).card ≤ ε ^ 2) :
    WeightedFourier b N j0 s σ ε

name: EOC.PsiShellBound.cshell_subset_two_intervals
statement:
theorem cshell_subset_two_intervals (r t u : ℕ) :
    cshell r t u ⊆ Ico (2 ^ u) (2 ^ u + 2 ^ u) ∪
      Ico (2 ^ (r + t) + 1 - 2 ^ (u + 1)) (2 ^ (r + t) + 1 - 2 ^ (u + 1) + 2 ^ u)

name: EOC.PsiShellBound.psi_cshell_sieve
statement:
theorem psi_cshell_sieve (b : ℕ → ℕ) (j0 σ t N u : ℕ) (hN1 : 1 ≤ N) (hNj : N < j0)
    (hX : 2 * PsiSieve.Xmax b N ≤ 2 ^ (σ + 1 + t)) :
    ∑ lam ∈ cshell (σ + 1) t u, ‖Psi (shellP b j0 σ) (σ + 1) t (yPrime j0 σ t) lam‖ ^ 2 ≤
      2 * sieveBound b j0 σ N (2 ^ u) ^ 2

name: EOC.PsiShellBound.sum_cshell_le_two_intervals
statement:
theorem sum_cshell_le_two_intervals (r t u : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℝ) (hF : ∀ lam, 0 ≤ F lam) :
    ∑ lam ∈ cshell r t u, F lam ≤
      ∑ k ∈ range (2 ^ u), F (2 ^ u + k) +
        ∑ k ∈ range (2 ^ u), F (2 ^ (r + t) + 1 - 2 ^ (u + 1) + k)

name: EOC.PsiShellBound.sum_interval_le_sieveBound_sq
statement:
theorem sum_interval_le_sieveBound_sq (b : ℕ → ℕ) (j0 σ t N : ℕ) (hN1 : 1 ≤ N) (hNj : N < j0)

statement:
theorem weightedFourier_of_psiSieve (b : ℕ → ℕ) (N j0 s σ : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (Nsplit : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hN1 : ∀ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)), 1 ≤ Nsplit u)
    (hNj : ∀ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)), Nsplit u < j0)
    (hX : ∀ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)), 2 * PsiSieve.Xmax b (Nsplit u) ≤ 2 ^ (σ + 1 + (s - σ)))
    (hfin : (1 + ((σ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) * ∑ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)),
        min 1 (2 ^ (s - σ) / (2 * 2 ^ u)) * (2 * sieveBound b j0 σ (Nsplit u) (2 ^ u) ^ 2) ≤
      ε ^ 2 * ((shellP b j0 σ).card : ℝ) ^ 2 * (shellV b N j0 σ (s - σ)).card / 2 ^ (s - σ)) :

name: EOC.PsiShellBound.weighted_sum_le_of_shell_sums_refined
statement:
theorem weighted_sum_le_of_shell_sums_refined (r t : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℝ) (sb : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ lam, 0 ≤ F lam)
    (hshell : ∀ u ∈ range (r + t), ∑ lam ∈ cshell r t u, F lam ≤ sb u) :
    ∑ g ∈ Ico 1 (2 ^ t), ∑ k ∈ range (2 ^ r), ‖coef r t (g + 2 ^ t * k)‖ * F (g + 2 ^ t * k) ≤
      ∑ u ∈ range (r + t), min 1 (2 ^ t / (2 * 2 ^ u)) * sb u

name: EOC.PowerOrbit.Psi_shell_shift

name: EOC.PowerOrbit.card_orbit_collisions_eq

      ((range W ×ˢ range W).filter fun p : ℕ × ℕ =>
        ((2 * 3 ^ (r - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ (p.2 : ℤ) - p.1).card

name: EOC.PowerOrbit.card_orbit_collisions_le
statement:

name: EOC.PowerOrbit.shell_sum_le_of_continuationSpreading
statement:
theorem shell_sum_le_of_continuationSpreading {j0 σ t : ℕ} {Nsplit : ℕ → ℕ} {C θ : ℝ}

name: EOC.PowerOrbit.weightedFourier_of_continuationSpreading
statement:

theorem kerZ_pow_le (V u : ℕ) (hu : u ≤ V) (n : ℤ) :

name: EOC.DecayInterface.kern_le_dyadic
statement:
theorem kern_le_dyadic (V : ℕ) (c : ℤ) (_hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hcV : c < 2 ^ V) :
    ∀ u, u ≤ V →
      (if c = 0 then (2 : ℝ) ^ u else min ((2 : ℝ) ^ u) ((2 : ℝ) ^ V / (2 * (c : ℝ)))) ≤
        (2 : ℝ) ^ u * (if c < 2 ^ (V - u) then 1 else 0) +
          ∑ v ∈ range u, (2 : ℝ) ^ v * (if c < 2 ^ (V - v) then 1 else 0)

name: EOC.DecayInterface.shellBounds_of_continuationSpreading
statement:
theorem shellBounds_of_continuationSpreading {j0 σ t : ℕ} {Nsplit : ℕ → ℕ} {C θ : ℝ}

    ∀ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + t), True →
      ∑ lam ∈ cshell (σ + 1) t u, ‖Psi (shellP b j0 σ) (σ + 1) t (yPrime j0 σ t) lam‖ ^ 2 ≤

name: EOC.DecayInterface.sum_kerZ_le_dyadic
statement:
theorem sum_kerZ_le_dyadic {ι : Type*} (T : Finset ι) (y : ι → ℤ) (V u : ℕ) (hu : u ≤ V) :
    ∑ i ∈ T, ∑ j ∈ T, kerZ (2 ^ u) (2 ^ V) (y i - y j) ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ u * pairSpacing T y (2 ^ V) (2 ^ (V - u)) +

name: EOC.DecayInterface.sum_sq_le_of_spacingExponent
statement:
theorem sum_sq_le_of_spacingExponent {ι : Type*} (T : Finset ι) (y : ι → ℤ) (a : ℝ) (V u : ℕ)
    (hu : u ≤ V) (C θ : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hθ : θ ≤ 1)
    (hE : ∀ v ≤ u, (pairSpacing T y (2 ^ V) (2 ^ (V - v)) : ℝ) ≤
      C * (T.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(θ * v)) + T.card) :
    ∑ k ∈ range (2 ^ u), ‖∑ i ∈ T, ee ((a + k) * ((y i : ℝ) / ((2 ^ V : ℤ) : ℝ)))‖ ^ 2 ≤
      C * (u + 1) * 2 ^ u * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(θ * u)) * (T.card : ℝ) ^ 2 + 2 * 2 ^ u * T.card

name: EOC.DecayInterface.weightedFourier_of_lowFreqDecay_and_sieve
statement:
theorem weightedFourier_of_lowFreqDecay_and_sieve (N j0 s σ U : ℕ) (ε C γ : ℝ)
    (Nsplit : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hN1 : ∀ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)), 1 ≤ Nsplit u)
    (hNj : ∀ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)), Nsplit u < j0)
    (hX : ∀ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)), 2 * PsiSieve.Xmax b (Nsplit u) ≤ 2 ^ (σ + 1 + (s - σ)))

        min 1 (2 ^ (s - σ) / (2 * 2 ^ u)) *
          mixedBound b j0 σ Nsplit (fun u => u ≤ U)
            (fun u => 2 ^ (u + 1) * C * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(γ * j0)) * ((shellP b j0 σ).card : ℝ) ^ 2) u ≤
      ε ^ 2 * ((shellP b j0 σ).card : ℝ) ^ 2 * (shellV b N j0 σ (s - σ)).card / 2 ^ (s - σ)) :

theorem avg_prod_le (T : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) (W : ι → ℕ → ℝ) (good : ι → ℕ → Prop)

    ∑ P ∈ T, w P * ∏ r ∈ range R, W P r ≤

name: EOC.BlockCubeInstance.norm_sq_le_classAvg
statement:
theorem norm_sq_le_classAvg (T : Finset ι) (κ : ι → β) (θ : ι → ℝ) (R : ℕ) (W : β → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hfac : ∀ c ∈ T.image κ,
      ‖∑ i ∈ T.filter (fun i => κ i = c), ee (θ i)‖ = nCls T κ c * ∏ r ∈ range R, W c r) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ T, ee (θ i)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (T.card : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        ((∑ c ∈ T.image κ, nCls T κ c * ∏ r ∈ range R, W c r ^ 2) /
          ∑ c ∈ T.image κ, nCls T κ c)

    (W : ℕ → κι → ℕ → ℝ) (good : ℕ → κι → ℕ → Prop) [∀ lam c, DecidablePred (good lam c)]
    (R G : ℕ) {κ C γ : ℝ} (hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ) (hκ1 : κ ≤ 1) (hw : ∀ c ∈ T, 0 ≤ w c)
    (hcube : GoodAngles.BlockCubeHyp b j0 σ t U T w W R)
    (hW : ∀ u ≤ U, ∀ lam ∈ cshell (σ + 1) t u, ∀ c ∈ T, ∀ r, 0 ≤ W lam c r ∧ W lam c r ≤ 1)
    (hgood : ∀ u ≤ U, ∀ lam ∈ cshell (σ + 1) t u, ∀ c ∈ T, ∀ r, good lam c r → W lam c r ≤ κ)
    (hgap : ∀ u ≤ U, ∀ lam ∈ cshell (σ + 1) t u, GoodGap T (good lam) R G)
    (hC0 : 0 ≤ C) (hrate : κ ^ (2 * (R / (G + 1))) ≤ C * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(γ * j0))) :

statement:

    {c ε : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ L₀ : ℝ, ∀ m L : ℕ, L₀ ≤ L → (m : ℝ) ≤ c * L →
      ∀ {κι : Type*} (j0 σ t U : ℕ) (T : Finset κι) (w : κι → ℝ) (W : ℕ → κι → ℕ → ℝ)
        (good : ℕ → κι → ℕ → Prop) [∀ lam c, DecidablePred (good lam c)] (R : ℕ) (G : ℝ → ℕ)
        {κ C γ : ℝ}, 0 ≤ κ → κ ≤ 1 → (∀ c ∈ T, 0 ≤ w c) →
        GoodAngles.BlockCubeHyp b j0 σ t U T w W R →
        (∀ u ≤ U, ∀ lam ∈ cshell (σ + 1) t u, ∀ c ∈ T, ∀ r, 0 ≤ W lam c r ∧ W lam c r ≤ 1) →
        (∀ u ≤ U, ∀ lam ∈ cshell (σ + 1) t u, ∀ c ∈ T, ∀ r, good lam c r → W lam c r ≤ κ) →
        (∀ u ≤ U, ∀ lam ∈ cshell (σ + 1) t u, TriangleGapBridge η (box m L) T (good lam) R G) →
        0 ≤ C → κ ^ (2 * (R / (G (ε * L) + 1))) ≤ C * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(γ * j0)) →
        DecayInterface.LowFreqDecay b j0 σ t U C γ

    n ≤ (2 * (⌊R₁ / Real.log 3⌋₊ + 1) + 1) *
        ((range n).filter (fun i => ¬ Blk (1 / 54) a b0 i)).card +
      ((range n).filter (fun i => Blk (1 / 54) a b0 i ∧ InBig (1 / 54) a b0 R₁ i)).card +
      (⌊R₁ / Real.log 3⌋₊ + 1) * ((range n).filter (fun i => 6 ≤ d i)).card +
      2 * (⌊R₁ / Real.log 3⌋₊ + 1)

name: EOC.WhiteContraction.weightedFourier_of_criticalWhiteCount
statement:
theorem weightedFourier_of_criticalWhiteCount {N j0 s σ U N0 k : ℕ} {ε d ρ C γ : ℝ}
    (Nsplit : ℕ → ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j0) (hne : (shellP b j0 σ).Nonempty) (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hN : 2 ≤ N0)
    (hcw : CriticalWhiteCount b j0 σ (s - σ) U N0 d k ρ) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C)
    (hrate : kappa d N0 ^ (2 * k) + ρ ≤ C * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(γ * j0)))
    (hN1 : ∀ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)), 1 ≤ Nsplit u)
    (hNj : ∀ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)), Nsplit u < j0)
    (hX : ∀ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)), 2 * PsiSieve.Xmax b (Nsplit u) ≤ 2 ^ (σ + 1 + (s - σ)))
    (hfin : (1 + ((σ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) * ∑ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)),
        min 1 (2 ^ (s - σ) / (2 * 2 ^ u)) *
          DecayInterface.mixedBound b j0 σ Nsplit (fun u => u ≤ U)
            (fun u => 2 ^ (u + 1) * C * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(γ * j0)) * ((shellP b j0 σ).card : ℝ) ^ 2) u ≤
      ε ^ 2 * ((shellP b j0 σ).card : ℝ) ^ 2 * (shellV b N j0 σ (s - σ)).card / 2 ^ (s - σ)) :
    WeightedChain.WeightedFourier b N j0 s σ ε

theorem sum_class_prod {ι β : Type*} [DecidableEq β] (T : Finset ι) (κ : ι → β)

    (hinj : Set.InjOn π ↑(T.filter (fun i => κ i = c)))
    (himg : (T.filter (fun i => κ i = c)).image π = Fintype.piFinset (fun r : Fin R => B c r))
    (g : Fin R → ℕ → ℝ) :

name: EOC.OddBlack.weightedFourier_of_shape_and_oddPressure
statement:
theorem weightedFourier_of_shape_and_oddPressure {N j0 s σ U N0 k n : ℕ} {ε d sv M ρ₁ ρ₂ C γ : ℝ}
    (Nsplit : ℕ → ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j0) (hne : (shellP b j0 σ).Nonempty) (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hN : 2 ≤ N0) (hsv : 1 ≤ sv) (hshape : ShapeTail b j0 σ N0 (k + n) ρ₁)
    (hodd : OddDarkPressure b j0 σ (s - σ) U d sv M) (hM : M ≤ ρ₂ * ((1 + sv) / 2) ^ n)
    (hC0 : 0 ≤ C) (hrate : kappa d N0 ^ (2 * k) + (ρ₁ + ρ₂) ≤ C * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(γ * j0)))
    (hN1 : ∀ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)), 1 ≤ Nsplit u)
    (hNj : ∀ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)), Nsplit u < j0)
    (hX : ∀ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)), 2 * PsiSieve.Xmax b (Nsplit u) ≤ 2 ^ (σ + 1 + (s - σ)))
    (hfin : (1 + ((σ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) * ∑ u ∈ range (σ + 1 + (s - σ)),
        min 1 (2 ^ (s - σ) / (2 * 2 ^ u)) *
          DecayInterface.mixedBound b j0 σ Nsplit (fun u => u ≤ U)
            (fun u => 2 ^ (u + 1) * C * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(γ * j0)) * ((shellP b j0 σ).card : ℝ) ^ 2) u ≤
      ε ^ 2 * ((shellP b j0 σ).card : ℝ) ^ 2 * (shellV b N j0 σ (s - σ)).card / 2 ^ (s - σ)) :
    WeightedChain.WeightedFourier b N j0 s σ ε

    (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    ∑ P ∈ shellP b j σ, s ^ Nodd b m d lam P ≤
      ((σ : ℝ) * j / (((j : ℝ) - 1) / ((σ : ℝ) - 1))) *
        ker (geoW (((j : ℝ) - 1) / ((σ : ℝ) - 1)) (((σ : ℝ) - j) / ((σ : ℝ) - 1))

name: EOC.CarryDomination.card_filter_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_le (s : Finset ι) (Z c T : ι → ZMod q)
    (hc : ∀ i, c i = 0 ∨ c i = 1) (hT : ∀ i, T i = Z i + c i) (t : ZMod q) :
    (s.filter (fun i => T i = t)).card
      ≤ (s.filter (fun i => Z i = t)).card + (s.filter (fun i => Z i = t - 1)).card

name: EOC.CarryDomination.filter_subset_union
statement:
theorem filter_subset_union [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (Z c T : ι → ZMod q)

    s.filter (fun i => T i = t) ⊆
      s.filter (fun i => Z i = t) ∪ s.filter (fun i => Z i = t - 1)

name: EOC.ChangHistory.changWord_S

name: EOC.ChangHistory.changWord_block_one

name: EOC.ChangHistory.changWord_block_two
statement:
theorem changWord_block_two (ys : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (ht : t < ys.length) :

name: EOC.ChangHistory.changWord_block_zero

name: EOC.ChangHistory.chang_event_positions
statement:
theorem chang_event_positions (ys : List Bool) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : Realizes (changWord ys) (3 * ys.length) m) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j + 1 < 3 * ys.length) :

name: EOC.ChangHistory.chang_history_labels
statement:
theorem chang_history_labels (ys : List Bool) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : Realizes (changWord ys) (3 * ys.length) m) (t : ℕ) (ht : t < ys.length) :
    orbit m (3 * t) % 16 = 9 ∧
    (orbit m (3 * t) % 32 = 25 ↔ ys.getD t false = true)

name: EOC.ChangHistory.every_finite_history_is_a_consecutive_chang_history
statement:
theorem every_finite_history_is_a_consecutive_chang_history
    (ys : List Bool) (hys : ys ≠ []) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧
      (∀ t, t < ys.length → orbit m (3 * t) % 16 = 9) ∧
      (∀ t, t < ys.length →
        (orbit m (3 * t) % 32 = 25 ↔ ys.getD t false = true)) ∧
      (∀ t j, t + 1 < ys.length → 3 * t < j → j < 3 * (t + 1) →
        orbit m j % 16 ≠ 9)

name: EOC.ChangHistory.finite_chang_history_realizable
statement:
theorem finite_chang_history_realizable (ys : List Bool) (hys : ys ≠ []) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ Odd m ∧
      (∀ j, j + 1 < 3 * ys.length →
        (orbit m j % 16 = 9 ↔ ∃ t, t < ys.length ∧ j = 3 * t)) ∧
      (∀ t, t < ys.length →
        orbit m (3 * t) % 16 = 9 ∧
        (orbit m (3 * t) % 32 = 25 ↔ ys.getD t false = true))

name: EOC.ChangHistory.label_iff

name: EOC.HarmonicFloor.R_le_of_nondescent_harmonic
statement:
theorem R_le_of_nondescent_harmonic (M N : ℕ) (hM : Odd M) (hM3 : 3 ≤ M)
    (hinj : ∀ i ≤ N, ∀ j ≤ N, orbit M i = orbit M j → i = j)
    (hge : ∀ i ≤ N, M ≤ orbit M i) :
    R (orbWord M) N ≤ (1 / (9 * Real.log 2)) * Real.log (1 + 3 * (N : ℝ) / ((M : ℝ) - 2))
      + 2 / (3 * Real.log 2 * ((M : ℝ) - 2))

name: EOC.HarmonicFloor.R_lt_of_orbit_eq

name: EOC.HarmonicFloor.band_occupancy
statement:
theorem band_occupancy (M N : ℕ) (hM : Odd M) (hM3 : 3 ≤ M) (A : ℝ)
    (hinj : ∀ i < N, ∀ j < N, orbit M i = orbit M j → i = j)
    (hge : ∀ i < N, M ≤ orbit M i) :
    (((range N).filter (fun j => -A ≤ R (orbWord M) j)).card : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-A)
      ≤ (M : ℝ) * carryU M N
        * (2 / ((M : ℝ) - 2) + (1 / 3) * Real.log (1 + 3 * (N : ℝ) / ((M : ℝ) - 2)))

name: EOC.HarmonicFloor.carryE_le_of_nondescent

    (hge : ∀ i < N, M ≤ orbit M i) :

      + 2 / (3 * Real.log 2 * ((M : ℝ) - 2))

name: EOC.HarmonicFloor.sum_inv_le_sum_inv_shift
statement:
theorem sum_inv_le_sum_inv_shift (m : ℕ → ℕ) (n M : ℕ) (hM3 : 3 ≤ M)
    (hinj : ∀ i < n, ∀ j < n, m i = m j → i = j)
    (hodd : ∀ i < n, Odd (m i)) (hthree : ∀ i < n, ¬ 3 ∣ m i)
    (hge : ∀ i < n, M ≤ m i) :
    ∑ k ∈ range n, (1 : ℝ) / (m k : ℝ)
      ≤ ∑ j ∈ range n, (1 : ℝ) / (((M : ℝ) - 2) + 3 * (j : ℝ))

name: EOC.HarmonicFloor.sum_inv_orbit_le_of_nondescent
statement:
theorem sum_inv_orbit_le_of_nondescent (M N : ℕ) (hM : Odd M) (hM3 : 3 ≤ M)
    (hinj : ∀ i < N, ∀ j < N, orbit M i = orbit M j → i = j)
    (hge : ∀ i < N, M ≤ orbit M i) :
    ∑ k ∈ range N, (1 : ℝ) / (orbit M k : ℝ)
      ≤ 2 / ((M : ℝ) - 2) + (1 / 3) * Real.log (1 + 3 * (N : ℝ) / ((M : ℝ) - 2))

name: EOC.HarmonicFloor.sum_le_sum_range_shift_of_antitone
statement:
theorem sum_le_sum_range_shift_of_antitone (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : Antitone f) (r₀ : ℕ) :
    ∀ T : Finset ℕ, (∀ x ∈ T, r₀ ≤ x) → ∑ x ∈ T, f x ≤ ∑ j ∈ range T.card, f (r₀ + j)

name: EOC.HarmonicFloor.sum_range_inv_shift_le
statement:
theorem sum_range_inv_shift_le (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ range n, (1 : ℝ) / (b + 3 * (j : ℝ))
      ≤ 1 / b + (1 / 3) * Real.log (1 + 3 * (n : ℝ) / b)

name: EOC.HarmonicFloor.sum_range_inv_shift_succ_le
statement:
theorem sum_range_inv_shift_succ_le (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ range n, (1 : ℝ) / (b + 3 * ((j : ℝ) + 1))
      ≤ (1 / 3) * (Real.log (b + 3 * (n : ℝ)) - Real.log b)

name: EOC.HarmonicFloor.sum_two_rpow_R_le
statement:
theorem sum_two_rpow_R_le (M N : ℕ) (hM : Odd M) :
    ∑ j ∈ range N, (2 : ℝ) ^ (R (orbWord M) j)
      ≤ (M : ℝ) * carryU M N * ∑ j ∈ range N, (1 : ℝ) / (orbit M j : ℝ)

name: EOC.Occupancy.capacity_lt_candidates
statement:

    (hpos : 0 < s.card) (hcard : q + h < s.card + 1) :

name: EOC.Occupancy.card_candidates_add_card_sameLabel
statement:
theorem card_candidates_add_card_sameLabel [DecidableEq Ω] :
    (candidates s z).card + (sameLabel s z).card = s.card ^ 2 + s.card

name: EOC.Occupancy.card_sameLabel
statement:
theorem card_sameLabel :

name: EOC.Occupancy.mem_candidates
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_candidates [DecidableEq Ω] {p : Ω × Ω} :
    p ∈ candidates s z ↔ (p.1 ∈ s ∧ p.2 ∈ s) ∧ (p.1 = p.2 ∨ z p.1 ≠ z p.2)

name: EOC.Occupancy.mem_sameLabel
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_sameLabel {p : Ω × Ω} :
    p ∈ sameLabel s z ↔ (p.1 ∈ s ∧ p.2 ∈ s) ∧ z p.1 = z p.2

name: EOC.Occupancy.mul_succ_le_candidates_add
statement:
theorem mul_succ_le_candidates_add [DecidableEq Ω] {q : ℕ} (hq : ∀ y, nOcc s z y ≤ q) :

name: EOC.Occupancy.sum_nOcc

name: EOC.Occupancy.sum_sq_nOcc_le

name: EOC.RenyiBarrier.aligned_attains
statement:
theorem aligned_attains {σ τ : Type*} (I : Finset τ) (U : Finset σ) (F : τ → σ → ℂ) (g : σ → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ S ∈ U, 0 ≤ g S) :
    ∃ c : τ → σ → ℂ, (∀ l S, ‖c l S‖ = 1) ∧
      ∑ l ∈ I, ‖∑ S ∈ U, F l S * ((g S : ℂ) * c l S)‖ ^ 2 =
        ∑ l ∈ I, (∑ S ∈ U, g S * ‖F l S‖) ^ 2

name: EOC.RenyiBarrier.aligned_attains_one
statement:
theorem aligned_attains_one {σ : Type*} (U : Finset σ) (F : σ → ℂ) (g : σ → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ S ∈ U, 0 ≤ g S) :
    ∃ c : σ → ℂ, (∀ S, ‖c S‖ = 1) ∧
      ‖∑ S ∈ U, F S * ((g S : ℂ) * c S)‖ = ∑ S ∈ U, g S * ‖F S‖

name: EOC.RenyiBarrier.aligned_lower_bound
statement:
theorem aligned_lower_bound {σ τ : Type*} (I : Finset τ) (U : Finset σ) (F : τ → σ → ℂ)
    (g : σ → ℝ) :
    (∑ l ∈ I, ∑ S ∈ U, g S * ‖F l S‖) ^ 2 ≤ I.card * ∑ l ∈ I, (∑ S ∈ U, g S * ‖F l S‖) ^ 2

name: EOC.RenyiBarrier.barrier
statement:
theorem barrier {σ τ : Type*} (I : Finset τ) (U : Finset σ) (F : τ → σ → ℂ) (g : σ → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ S ∈ U, 0 ≤ g S) :
    ∃ c : τ → σ → ℂ, (∀ l S, ‖c l S‖ = 1) ∧
      (∑ l ∈ I, ∑ S ∈ U, g S * ‖F l S‖) ^ 2 ≤
        I.card * ∑ l ∈ I, ‖∑ S ∈ U, F l S * ((g S : ℂ) * c l S)‖ ^ 2

name: EOC.RenyiBarrier.card_sharePairs
statement:
theorem card_sharePairs (T : Finset ι) (pre : ι → κ) :
    (sharePairs T pre).card = ∑ c ∈ T.image pre, (fibre T pre c).card ^ 2

name: EOC.RenyiBarrier.hasSum_geometric_sq
statement:
theorem hasSum_geometric_sq {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) :
    HasSum (fun d : ℕ => (p * (1 - p) ^ d) ^ 2) (p ^ 2 / (1 - (1 - p) ^ 2))

name: EOC.RenyiBarrier.mul_alignPhase
statement: theorem mul_alignPhase (z : ℂ) : z * alignPhase z = (‖z‖ : ℂ)

name: EOC.RenyiBarrier.norm_alignPhase

name: EOC.RenyiBarrier.norm_sum_le_of_bound
statement:
theorem norm_sum_le_of_bound {σ : Type*} (U : Finset σ) (F G : σ → ℂ) (g : σ → ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ S ∈ U, ‖G S‖ ≤ g S) :
    ‖∑ S ∈ U, F S * G S‖ ≤ ∑ S ∈ U, g S * ‖F S‖

name: EOC.RenyiBarrier.renyi_closed_form
statement:
theorem renyi_closed_form {α : ℝ} (hα : 1 < α) :
    -Real.logb 2 ((1 / α) ^ 2 / (1 - (1 - 1 / α) ^ 2)) =
      2 * Real.logb 2 α + Real.logb 2 (1 - (1 - 1 / α) ^ 2)

name: EOC.RenyiBarrier.renyi_of_geometric
statement:
theorem renyi_of_geometric {α : ℝ} (hα : 1 < α) :
    -Real.logb 2 (∑' d : ℕ, (1 / α * (1 - 1 / α) ^ d) ^ 2) =
      2 * Real.logb 2 α + Real.logb 2 (1 - (1 - 1 / α) ^ 2)

name: EOC.RenyiBarrier.sq_card_le_image_mul_sharePairs
statement:
theorem sq_card_le_image_mul_sharePairs (T : Finset ι) (pre : ι → κ) :
    T.card ^ 2 ≤ (T.image pre).card * (sharePairs T pre).card

name: EOC.RenyiBarrier.sum_card_fibre
statement:
theorem sum_card_fibre (T : Finset ι) (pre : ι → κ) :
    ∑ c ∈ T.image pre, (fibre T pre c).card = T.card

name: EOC.RenyiBarrier.sum_sq_le_aligned
statement:
theorem sum_sq_le_aligned {σ τ : Type*} (I : Finset τ) (U : Finset σ) (F G : τ → σ → ℂ)
    (g : σ → ℝ) (hG : ∀ l ∈ I, ∀ S ∈ U, ‖G l S‖ ≤ g S) :
    ∑ l ∈ I, ‖∑ S ∈ U, F l S * G l S‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ l ∈ I, (∑ S ∈ U, g S * ‖F l S‖) ^ 2

name: EOC.RenyiBarrier.tsum_geometric_sq
statement:
theorem tsum_geometric_sq {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) :
    ∑' d : ℕ, (p * (1 - p) ^ d) ^ 2 = p ^ 2 / (1 - (1 - p) ^ 2)

name: EOC.RenyiInstance.aligned_split_attains
statement:
theorem aligned_split_attains (m j0 N σ a H : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ, (∀ k S, ‖c k S‖ = 1) ∧
      ∑ k ∈ range H, ‖∑ S ∈ range (σ + 1),
          Fpre b m N S (a + k) * ((gS b j0 N σ S : ℂ) * c k S)‖ ^ 2 =
        ∑ k ∈ range H, (∑ S ∈ range (σ + 1), gS b j0 N σ S * ‖Fpre b m N S (a + k)‖) ^ 2

name: EOC.RenyiInstance.card_prefix_sharing
statement:
theorem card_prefix_sharing (j0 σ N : ℕ) :
    (sharePairs (shellP b j0 σ) (fun P => pre N P)).card =
      ∑ c ∈ (shellP b j0 σ).image (fun P => pre N P),
        (fibre (shellP b j0 σ) (fun P => pre N P) c).card ^ 2

name: EOC.RenyiInstance.gS_nonneg
statement: theorem gS_nonneg (j0 N σ S : ℕ) : 0 ≤ gS b j0 N σ S

name: EOC.RenyiInstance.norm_Gsuf_le_gS
statement: theorem norm_Gsuf_le_gS (m j0 N σ S lam : ℕ) : ‖Gsuf b m j0 N σ S lam‖ ≤ gS b j0 N σ S

name: EOC.RenyiInstance.norm_aligned_eq
statement:
theorem norm_aligned_eq (j0 N σ S : ℕ) {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) :
    ‖(gS b j0 N σ S : ℂ) * z‖ = gS b j0 N σ S

name: EOC.RenyiInstance.path_sq_le_aligned
statement:
theorem path_sq_le_aligned (m j0 N σ a H : ℕ) (hN1 : 1 ≤ N) (hNj : N < j0) :
    ∑ k ∈ range H, ‖∑ P ∈ shellP b j0 σ,
        ∏ i ∈ range j0, SwapBound.ee (cp (a + k) m i (P.prefixSum i))‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ k ∈ range H, (∑ S ∈ range (σ + 1), gS b j0 N σ S * ‖Fpre b m N S (a + k)‖) ^ 2

name: EOC.RenyiInstance.split_barrier
statement:
theorem split_barrier (m j0 N σ a H : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ, (∀ k S, ‖c k S‖ = 1) ∧
      (∑ k ∈ range H, ∑ S ∈ range (σ + 1), gS b j0 N σ S * ‖Fpre b m N S (a + k)‖) ^ 2 ≤
        (range H).card * ∑ k ∈ range H, ‖∑ S ∈ range (σ + 1),
          Fpre b m N S (a + k) * ((gS b j0 N σ S : ℂ) * c k S)‖ ^ 2

name: EOC.RenyiInstance.sq_card_shellP_le_prefix_sharing
statement:
theorem sq_card_shellP_le_prefix_sharing (j0 σ N : ℕ) :
    (shellP b j0 σ).card ^ 2 ≤
      ((shellP b j0 σ).image (fun P => pre N P)).card *
        (sharePairs (shellP b j0 σ) (fun P => pre N P)).card

name: EOC.RenyiInstance.sum_sq_split_le_aligned
statement:
theorem sum_sq_split_le_aligned (m j0 N σ a H : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range H, ‖∑ S ∈ range (σ + 1), Fpre b m N S (a + k) * Gsuf b m j0 N σ S (a + k)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ k ∈ range H, (∑ S ∈ range (σ + 1), gS b j0 N σ S * ‖Fpre b m N S (a + k)‖) ^ 2
